+package dev.pocketrun.agent.opencode
+
+import dev.pocketrun.core.Workspace
+import org.json.JSONArray
+import org.json.JSONObject
+import java.io.File
+
+/**
+ * The opencode config, read from `opencode.json` plus the `.opencode/` folders.
+ *
+ * Two locations are merged: the global one (`<workspace>/opencode/opencode.json`
+ * stands in for `~/.config/opencode/opencode.json` on the device) and the
+ * project one (`.opencode/opencode.json`, or `opencode.json` in the project
+ * root). Project values win over global ones, key by key.
+ *
+ * What is actually used by the app:
+ *  - `model`       — the model the agent uses for this project;
+ *  - `permission`  — per-tool `allow` / `ask` / `deny`, with `bash`-style glob
+ *                    patterns for a finer grain (e.g. `{ "rm *": "deny" }`);
+ *  - `agent`       — custom agents (`.opencode/agent/*.md` too): prompt, model,
+ *                    tool allow-list, usable as primary or as a `task` type;
+ *  - `command`     — custom slash commands (`.opencode/command/*.md` too).
+ */
+class OpenCodeConfig private constructor(
+    val model: String?,
+    private val permissions: Map<String, PermissionRule>,
+    val agents: Map<String, AgentDef>,
+    val commands: Map<String, CommandDef>,
+) {
+
+    enum class Permission { ALLOW, ASK, DENY }
+
+    sealed interface PermissionRule {
+        data class Simple(val permission: Permission) : PermissionRule
+
+        /** Patterns in "most specific first" order; the first match wins. */
+        data class Patterned(val entries: List<Pair<String, Permission>>) : PermissionRule
+    }
+
+    data class AgentDef(
+        val name: String,
+        val description: String,
+        val mode: String?,
+        val model: String?,
+        val prompt: String?,
+        val tools: Set<String>?,
+        val global: Boolean,
+        val file: File?,
+    )
+
+    data class CommandDef(
+        val name: String,
+        val description: String,
+        val template: String,
+        val agent: String?,
+        val model: String?,
+        val global: Boolean,
+    )
+
+    /**
+     * The configured permission for a tool call, or null when the config says
+     * nothing about it (the caller then applies its own default).
+     *
+     * [keyArg] is the value patterns are matched against — the bash command,
+     * the file path, the URL, the github op, the task type.
+     */
+    fun permissionFor(tool: String, keyArg: String): Permission? =
+        when (val rule = permissions[normalizeTool(tool)]) {
+            null -> null
+            is PermissionRule.Simple -> rule.permission
+            is PermissionRule.Patterned -> rule.entries.firstOrNull { globMatches(it.first, keyArg) }?.second
+        }
+
+    fun agent(name: String): AgentDef? = agents[name]
+
+    fun command(name: String): CommandDef? = commands[name]
+
+    /** Every command name, sorted, for `/help`. */
+    fun commandNames(): List<String> = commands.keys.sorted()
+
+    /** Every agent name, sorted, for `/agents`. */
+    fun agentNames(): List<String> = agents.keys.sorted()
+
+    companion object {
+        /** Agent names that ship with the app (also valid `task` types). */
+        val BUILTIN_AGENTS = listOf("build", "plan", "explore", "general")
+
+        private val TOOL_ALIASES = mapOf(
+            "edit" to "edit", "write" to "write", "patch" to "apply_patch",
+            "apply_patch" to "apply_patch", "bash" to "bash", "read" to "read",
+            "list" to "list", "glob" to "glob", "grep" to "grep",
+            "webfetch" to "webfetch", "skill" to "skill", "question" to "question",
+            "todowrite" to "todowrite", "github" to "github", "task" to "task",
+        )
+
+        val EMPTY = OpenCodeConfig(null, emptyMap(), emptyMap(), emptyMap())
+
+        fun load(workspace: Workspace, projectDir: File?): OpenCodeConfig {
+            val global = File(workspace.root, "opencode")
+            val globalJson = File(global, "opencode.json")
+            val projectJson = projectDir?.let { dir ->
+                listOf(File(dir, ".opencode/opencode.json"), File(dir, "opencode.json"))
+                    .firstOrNull { it.isFile }
+            }
+
+            val model = projectJson?.let { optString(it, "model") }
+                ?: optString(globalJson, "model")
+
+            val permissions = LinkedHashMap<String, PermissionRule>()
+            parsePermission(globalJson)?.let { permissions.putAll(it) }
+            parsePermission(projectJson)?.let { permissions.putAll(it) }
+
+            val agents = LinkedHashMap<String, AgentDef>()
+            agents.putAll(scanAgentDir(File(global, "agent"), global = true))
+            if (projectDir != null) agents.putAll(scanAgentDir(File(projectDir, ".opencode/agent"), global = false))
+            mergeAgentJson(agents, globalJson, global = true)
+            mergeAgentJson(agents, projectJson, global = false)
+
+            val commands = LinkedHashMap<String, CommandDef>()
+            commands.putAll(scanCommandDir(File(global, "command"), global = true))
+            if (projectDir != null) commands.putAll(scanCommandDir(File(projectDir, ".opencode/command"), global = false))
+            mergeCommandJson(commands, globalJson, global = true)
+            mergeCommandJson(commands, projectJson, global = false)
+
+            return OpenCodeConfig(model, permissions, agents, commands)
+        }
+
+        /** Bash/glob patterns: `*` and `?`, anchored at both ends. */
+        fun globMatches(pattern: String, value: String): Boolean {
+            val regex = buildString {
+                append('^')
+                for (c in pattern) {
+                    when (c) {
+                        '*' -> append(".*")
+                        '?' -> append('.')
+                        else -> if (c in "\\^$.|+()[]{}") { append('\\'); append(c) } else append(c)
+                    }
+                }
+                append('$')
+            }
+            return Regex(regex).matches(value)
+        }
+
+        /** The argument patterns are matched against, per tool. */
+        fun keyArgFor(tool: String, args: JSONObject): String = when (tool) {
+            "bash" -> args.optString("command")
+            "read", "write", "edit" -> args.optString("filePath")
+            "list", "glob", "grep" -> args.optString("path")
+            "webfetch" -> args.optString("url")
+            "skill" -> args.optString("name")
+            "github" -> args.optString("op")
+            "task" -> args.optString("subagent_type")
+            else -> ""
+        }
+
+        // ------------------------------------------------------------ parsing
+
+        private fun normalizeTool(tool: String): String = TOOL_ALIASES[tool] ?: tool
+
+        private fun parsePermission(file: File?): Map<String, PermissionRule>? {
+            val json = readJson(file) ?: return null
+            val obj = json.optJSONObject("permission") ?: return null
+            val out = LinkedHashMap<String, PermissionRule>()
+            val keys = obj.keys()
+            while (keys.hasNext()) {
+                val tool = keys.next()
+                when (val value = obj.opt(tool)) {
+                    is String -> parsePermissionValue(value)?.let { out[normalizeTool(tool)] = PermissionRule.Simple(it) }
+                    is JSONObject -> {
+                        val entries = mutableListOf<Pair<String, Permission>>()
+                        val pKeys = value.keys()
+                        while (pKeys.hasNext()) {
+                            val pattern = pKeys.next()
+                            parsePermissionValue(value.optString(pattern))?.let { entries += pattern to it }
+                        }
+                        if (entries.isNotEmpty()) {
+                            // Most specific pattern first, so `rm *` beats `*`.
+                            entries.sortByDescending { it.first.replace("*", "").replace("?", "").length }
+                            out[normalizeTool(tool)] = PermissionRule.Patterned(entries)
+                        }
+                    }
+                }
+            }
+            return out
+        }
+
+        private fun parsePermissionValue(raw: String?): Permission? = when (raw?.trim()?.lowercase()) {
+            "allow", "true", "yes" -> Permission.ALLOW
+            "ask", "confirm" -> Permission.ASK
+            "deny", "false", "no" -> Permission.DENY
+            else -> null
+        }
+
+        private fun mergeAgentJson(into: MutableMap<String, AgentDef>, file: File?, global: Boolean) {
+            val json = readJson(file) ?: return
+            val obj = json.optJSONObject("agent") ?: return
+            val keys = obj.keys()
+            while (keys.hasNext()) {
+                val name = keys.next()
+                if (!Skills.nameMatches(name)) continue
+                val a = obj.optJSONObject(name) ?: continue
+                into[name] = AgentDef(
+                    name = name,
+                    description = a.optString("description"),
+                    mode = a.optString("mode").takeIf { it.isNotBlank() },
+                    model = a.optString("model").takeIf { it.isNotBlank() },
+                    prompt = a.optString("prompt").takeIf { it.isNotBlank() },
+                    tools = parseTools(a.opt("tools")),
+                    global = global,
+                    file = file,
+                )
+            }
+        }
+
+        private fun mergeCommandJson(into: MutableMap<String, CommandDef>, file: File?, global: Boolean) {
+            val json = readJson(file) ?: return
+            val obj = json.optJSONObject("command") ?: return
+            val keys = obj.keys()
+            while (keys.hasNext()) {
+                val name = keys.next()
+                val c = obj.optJSONObject(name) ?: continue
+                val template = c.optString("template")
+                if (template.isBlank()) continue
+                into[name] = CommandDef(
+                    name = name,
+                    description = c.optString("description"),
+                    template = template,
+                    agent = c.optString("agent").takeIf { it.isNotBlank() },
+                    model = c.optString("model").takeIf { it.isNotBlank() },
+                    global = global,
+                )
+            }
+        }
+
+        private fun parseTools(value: Any?): Set<String>? = when (value) {
+            is JSONArray -> (0 until value.length()).mapNotNull { value.optString(it).takeIf { s -> s.isNotBlank() } }.toSet()
+            is String -> value.split(',', ' ').map { it.trim() }.filter { it.isNotEmpty() }.toSet()
+            is JSONObject -> {
+                // opencode's { "bash": true, "edit": false } form.
+                val out = mutableSetOf<String>()
+                val keys = value.keys()
+                while (keys.hasNext()) {
+                    val k = keys.next()
+                    if (value.optBoolean(k, false)) out += k
+                }
+                out
+            }
+            else -> null
+        }?.takeIf { it.isNotEmpty() }
+
+        // ------------------------------------------------------------ folders
+
+        private fun scanAgentDir(dir: File, global: Boolean): List<Pair<String, AgentDef>> {
+            if (!dir.isDirectory) return emptyList()
+            return dir.listFiles { f -> f.isFile && f.name.endsWith(".md") }.orEmpty().mapNotNull { file ->
+                val name = file.name.removeSuffix(".md")
+                if (!Skills.nameMatches(name)) return@mapNotNull null
+                val (front, body) = readMarkdown(file)
+                val a = AgentDef(
+                    name = name,
+                    description = front["description"].orEmpty(),
+                    mode = front["mode"]?.takeIf { it.isNotBlank() },
+                    model = front["model"]?.takeIf { it.isNotBlank() },
+                    prompt = body.takeIf { it.isNotBlank() },
+                    tools = front["tools"]?.let { parseTools(it) },
+                    global = global,
+                    file = file,
+                )
+                name to a
+            }
+        }
+
+        private fun scanCommandDir(dir: File, global: Boolean): List<Pair<String, CommandDef>> {
+            if (!dir.isDirectory) return emptyList()
+            return dir.listFiles { f -> f.isFile && f.name.endsWith(".md") }.orEmpty().mapNotNull { file ->
+                val name = file.name.removeSuffix(".md")
+                if (name.isBlank()) return@mapNotNull null
+                val (front, body) = readMarkdown(file)
+                if (body.isBlank()) return@mapNotNull null
+                name to CommandDef(
+                    name = name,
+                    description = front["description"].orEmpty(),
+                    template = body,
+                    agent = front["agent"]?.takeIf { it.isNotBlank() },
+                    model = front["model"]?.takeIf { it.isNotBlank() },
+                    global = global,
+                )
+            }
+        }
+
+        /** Frontmatter (reusing the skill parser) plus the body after it. */
+        private fun readMarkdown(file: File): Pair<Map<String, String>, String> {
+            val text = runCatching { file.readText(Charsets.UTF_8) }.getOrDefault("")
+            val front = Skills.parseFrontmatter(text)
+            if (!text.startsWith("---")) return front to text.trim()
+            val lines = text.lines()
+            var i = 1
+            while (i < lines.size && lines[i].trim() != "---") i++
+            val body = if (i < lines.size) lines.drop(i + 1).joinToString("\n") else ""
+            return front to body.trim()
+        }
+
+        private fun readJson(file: File?): JSONObject? {
+            if (file == null || !file.isFile) return null
+            return runCatching { JSONObject(file.readText(Charsets.UTF_8)) }.getOrNull()
+        }
+
+        private fun optString(file: File?, key: String): String? {
+            val json = readJson(file) ?: return null
+            return json.optString(key).trim().takeIf { it.isNotEmpty() }
+        }
+    }
+}

     private val workspace: Workspace,
     jsRuntime: SyncScriptRuntime,
     npxRuntime: NpxRuntime,
     private val projectDir: File?,

         private const val MAX_TOOL_OUTPUT = 16 * 1024
         private const val MAX_WEB = 24 * 1024
 
         /** A single bash command may run this long — npm installs and builds need it. */
         const val BASH_TIMEOUT_MS = 300_000L
 
         /** Tools a subagent of [type] may use (subagents cannot ask or nest). */
         fun subagentTools(type: String): Set<String> = when (type) {
             "explore" -> setOf("read", "list", "glob", "grep", "webfetch")
             else -> setOf(
                 "bash", "read", "write", "edit", "list", "glob", "grep",
                 "apply_patch", "todowrite", "webfetch", "skill", "github",
             )
         }
     }

     private val skills = Skills(workspace)

     @Volatile

      * invoked for mutating tools (writes, edits, bash, github mutations);
      * reads always run. Set by the runner when the mode is "manual".
      */
     @Volatile
     var toolApprover: ((name: String, argsJson: String) -> Boolean)? = null
 
     /**

      * a turn that is only waiting for a CI run.

     @Volatile
     var cancelCheck: (() -> Boolean)? = null

     @Volatile
     var onTodos: ((List<Sessions.Todo>) -> Unit)? = null

     private fun doBash(args: JSONObject): String {
         val command = args.getString("command")
         val timeout = args.optLong("timeout", BASH_TIMEOUT_MS).coerceIn(1_000, BASH_TIMEOUT_MS)
         val r = shell.execute(command, base(), timeout)
         val out = buildString {
             append("exit code: ").append(r.exitCode).append('\n')
             if (r.output.isNotBlank()) append(r.output.trimEnd()).append('\n')
         }
         return out.trim().take(MAX_TOOL_OUTPUT)
     }
 
     private fun doRead(args: JSONObject): String {
         val f = resolve(args.getString("filePath")) ?: return "error: путь вне песочницы"
         if (!f.exists()) return "error: файл не найден: ${args.getString("filePath")}"
         if (f.isDirectory) return "error: это каталог, используйте list"
         val text = f.readText(Charsets.UTF_8)
         val offset = args.optInt("offset", 1).coerceAtLeast(1)
         val limit = args.optInt("limit", 0)
         val lines = text.lines()
         val from = (offset - 1).coerceIn(0, lines.size)
         val to = if (limit > 0) minOf(from + limit, lines.size) else lines.size
         val picked = lines.subList(from, to)
         val body = picked.joinToString("\n")
         return (body.take(MAX_READ) + if (body.length > MAX_READ) "\n… (обрезано)" else "")
             .ifEmpty { "(пустой файл)" }
     }
 
     private fun doWrite(args: JSONObject): String {
         val path = args.getString("filePath")
         if (path.isBlank()) return "error: пустой путь"
         val f = resolve(path) ?: return "error: путь вне песочницы"
         f.parentFile?.mkdirs()
         f.writeText(args.optString("content", ""), Charsets.UTF_8)
         return "wrote ${args.optString("content", "").length} chars to ${workspace.relativeTo(f)}"
     }
 
     private fun doEdit(args: JSONObject): String {
         val f = resolve(args.getString("filePath")) ?: return "error: путь вне песочницы"
         if (!f.isFile) return "error: файл не найден: ${args.getString("filePath")}"
         val old = args.getString("oldString")
         val new = args.optString("newString", "")
         if (old.isEmpty()) return "error: oldString пуст"
         val text = f.readText(Charsets.UTF_8)
         val count = countOccurrences(text, old)
         if (count == 0) return "error: oldString не найден в файле"
         if (count > 1 && !args.optBoolean("replaceAll", false)) {
             return "error: oldString встречается $count раз — уточните текст или передайте replaceAll: true"
         }
         val updated = if (args.optBoolean("replaceAll", false)) text.replace(old, new) else text.replaceFirst(old, new)
         f.writeText(updated, Charsets.UTF_8)
         return "ok: заменено вхождений: ${if (args.optBoolean("replaceAll", false)) count else 1}"
     }
 
     private fun doList(args: JSONObject): String {
         val path = args.optString("path", ".")
         val dir = resolve(path) ?: return "error: путь вне песочницы"
         if (!dir.exists()) return "error: нет такого каталога: $path"
         if (!dir.isDirectory) return "error: не каталог: $path"
         val entries = dir.listFiles()?.sortedWith(compareByDescending<File> { it.isDirectory }.thenBy { it.name }) ?: return "(empty)"
         if (entries.isEmpty()) return "(empty)"
         return entries.take(200).joinToString("\n") { f -> if (f.isDirectory) f.name + "/" else f.name + " (${f.length()} bytes)" }
     }
 
     private fun doGlob(args: JSONObject): String {
         val pattern = args.getString("pattern")
         val dir = resolve(args.optString("path", ".")) ?: return "error: путь вне песочницы"
         val base = dir.takeIf { it.isDirectory } ?: workspace.root
         val matches = mutableListOf<File>()
         base.walkTopDown().forEach { f ->
             if (f.isFile) {
                 val rel = f.relativeToOrNull(base)?.path ?: return@forEach
                 if (globToRegex(pattern).matches(rel)) matches += f
             }
         }
         if (matches.isEmpty()) return "(нет совпадений)"
         return matches.sortedByDescending { it.lastModified() }
             .take(200)
             .joinToString("\n") { workspace.relativeTo(it) }
     }
 
     private fun doGrep(args: JSONObject): String {
         val pattern = try { Regex(args.getString("pattern")) } catch (t: Throwable) { return "error: плохой regex: ${t.message}" }
         val dir = resolve(args.optString("path", ".")) ?: return "error: путь вне песочницы"
         val base = dir.takeIf { it.isDirectory } ?: workspace.root
         val include = args.optString("include").takeIf { it.isNotBlank() }?.let { globToRegex(it) }
         val out = StringBuilder()
         base.walkTopDown().forEach { f ->
             if (out.length > MAX_TOOL_OUTPUT) return@forEach
             if (!f.isFile || f.length() > 512 * 1024) return@forEach
             val rel = workspace.relativeTo(f)
             if (include != null && !include.matches(f.name) && !include.matches(rel)) return@forEach
             val text = runCatching { f.readText(Charsets.UTF_8) }.getOrNull() ?: return@forEach
             text.lines().forEachIndexed { idx, line ->
                 if (pattern.containsMatchIn(line)) out.append("$rel:${idx + 1}: ${line.take(300)}\n")
             }
         }
         return out.toString().trim().take(MAX_TOOL_OUTPUT).ifEmpty { "(нет совпадений)" }
     }

     private fun doTodoWrite(args: JSONObject): String {

         for (i in 0 until arr.length()) {

         onTodos?.invoke(list)
         return "todos updated: ${list.size}"

     private fun doWebFetch(args: JSONObject): String {
         val url = args.getString("url")
         if (!url.startsWith("http://") && !url.startsWith("https://")) return "error: только http(s) URL"
         return try {
             val conn = URL(url).openConnection() as HttpURLConnection
             conn.connectTimeout = 10_000
             conn.readTimeout = 30_000
             conn.instanceFollowRedirects = true
             conn.setRequestProperty("User-Agent", "Mozilla/5.0 (compatible; PocketRunAgent/1.3)")
             val status = conn.responseCode
             val body = (if (status in 200..299) conn.inputStream else conn.errorStream)
                 ?.bufferedReader(Charsets.UTF_8)?.use { it.readText() } ?: ""
             if (status !in 200..299) return "HTTP $status: ${body.take(300)}"
             val text = stripHtml(body)
             text.take(MAX_WEB).ifEmpty { "(пустой ответ)" }
         } catch (t: Throwable) {
             "error: ${t.message ?: t.javaClass.simpleName}"
         }
     }

         if (githubToken.isBlank()) {
             return "error: GitHub-токен не задан — откройте ⚙ → GitHub и вставьте PAT (scopes repo, workflow)"
         }
         val gh = GitHubClient(githubToken)
         val op = args.optString("op")
         return try {
             when (op) {
                 "me" -> gh.me()
                 "repo_list" -> gh.repoList()
                 "repo_create" -> gh.repoCreate(
                     name = args.getString("name"),
                     private = args.optBoolean("private", true),
                     description = args.optString("description").takeIf { it.isNotEmpty() },
                 )
                 "push" -> {
                     val arr = args.optJSONArray("files") ?: return "error: нужен массив files[{path,content}]"
                     val files = mutableListOf<Pair<String, String>>()
                     for (i in 0 until arr.length()) {
                         val f = arr.optJSONObject(i) ?: continue
                         val p = f.optString("path")
                         if (p.isNotEmpty()) files += p to f.optString("content")
                     }
                     if (files.isEmpty()) return "error: files пуст"
                     gh.pushFiles(args.getString("repo"), files, args.optString("message", "update"), args.optString("branch").takeIf { it.isNotEmpty() })
                 }
                 "file_get" -> gh.fileGet(args.getString("repo"), args.getString("path"), args.optString("ref").takeIf { it.isNotEmpty() })
                 "file_delete" -> {
                     val arr = args.optJSONArray("paths")
                         ?: return "error: нужен массив paths[]"
                     val paths = (0 until arr.length()).mapNotNull { arr.optString(it).takeIf { p -> p.isNotEmpty() } }
                     if (paths.isEmpty()) return "error: paths пуст"
                     gh.deleteFiles(
                         args.getString("repo"), paths,
                         args.optString("message", "remove files"),
                         args.optString("branch").takeIf { it.isNotEmpty() },
                     )
                 }
                 "workflow_create" -> gh.workflowCreate(args.getString("repo"), args.optString("filename", "run.yml"), args.getString("yaml"))
                 "dispatch" -> gh.dispatch(args.getString("repo"), args.getString("workflow"), args.optString("ref").takeIf { it.isNotEmpty() })
                 "runs" -> gh.runs(args.getString("repo"), args.optInt("limit", 10))
                 "run_wait" -> gh.runWait(
                     repo = args.getString("repo"),
                     runId = args.optLong("run_id", 0).takeIf { it != 0L },
                     timeoutSec = args.optInt("timeout_sec", 600),
                     isCancelled = { cancelCheck?.invoke() == true },
                 )
                 "run_cancel" -> gh.runCancel(args.getString("repo"), args.getLong("run_id"))
                 "logs" -> gh.logs(args.getString("repo"), args.getLong("run_id"))
                 "artifacts" -> gh.artifacts(args.getString("repo"), args.optLong("run_id", 0).takeIf { it != 0L })
                 "artifact_download" -> gh.artifactDownload(args.getString("repo"), args.getLong("artifact_id"))
                 "api" -> gh.api(args.optString("method", "GET"), args.getString("api_path"), args.optString("body").takeIf { it.isNotEmpty() })
                 else -> "error: неизвестная операция '$op' (me, repo_list, repo_create, push, file_delete, file_get, workflow_create, dispatch, runs, run_wait, run_cancel, logs, artifacts, artifact_download, api)"
             }
         } catch (e: GitHubClient.GitHubException) {
             "error: ${e.message}"
         }
     }

     private fun resolve(path: String): File? = workspace.resolve(path, base())
 
     private fun countOccurrences(text: String, needle: String): Int {
         var count = 0
         var idx = 0
         while (true) {
             idx = text.indexOf(needle, idx)
             if (idx < 0) return count
             count++
             idx += needle.length
         }
     }
 
     private fun globToRegex(pattern: String): Regex {
         val regex = buildString {
             append('^')
             var i = 0
             while (i < pattern.length) {
                 when (val c = pattern[i]) {

package dev.pocketrun.agent

import android.content.Context

/**
 * Agent configuration, stored in SharedPreferences. Works with any
 * OpenAI-compatible `/chat/completions` endpoint: OpenAI, OpenRouter, Groq,
 * Together, a local llama.cpp/vLLM server on the Wi-Fi network, …
 *
 * Also carries the agent-behaviour knobs (permission mode, max rounds) and
 * the optional GitHub token used by the `github` tool.
 */
object AgentSettings {

    const val DEFAULT_BASE_URL = "https://api.openai.com/v1"
    const val DEFAULT_MODEL = "gpt-4o-mini"

    /** opencode Zen: the curated OpenAI-compatible gateway from opencode.ai/auth. */
    const val ZEN_BASE_URL = "https://opencode.ai/zen/v1"
    const val ZEN_AUTH_URL = "https://opencode.ai/auth"

    /** Where the user creates a GitHub PAT (scopes: repo, workflow). */
    const val GITHUB_TOKEN_URL = "https://github.com/settings/tokens/new?scopes=repo,workflow&description=PocketRun"
    const val GITHUB_API = "https://api.github.com"

    /** Permission modes for tool execution. */
    const val MODE_AUTO = "auto"     // everything runs without asking
    const val MODE_MANUAL = "manual" // mutations need a tap; reads run freely
    const val MODE_ASK = "ask"       // the agent asks clarifying questions first
    val MODES = listOf(MODE_AUTO, MODE_MANUAL, MODE_ASK)
    val MODE_LABELS = mapOf(MODE_AUTO to "Авто", MODE_MANUAL to "Вручную", MODE_ASK to "Вопросы")

    /**
     * Model rounds per user request. Each round is one model call plus the
     * tools it asked for, so a real task (edit a project, push it, wait for the
     * CI run, fix what broke) needs dozens of them — the old default of 12
     * stopped agents in the middle of ordinary work.
     */
    const val DEFAULT_MAX_STEPS = 40
    const val MAX_STEPS_LIMIT = 500

    /** Ready-made presets shown in the model settings dialog. */
    data class Preset(val label: String, val baseUrl: String, val model: String)

    val PRESETS = listOf(
        Preset("OpenCode Zen", ZEN_BASE_URL, "claude-sonnet-4-5"),
        Preset("OpenAI", "https://api.openai.com/v1", "gpt-4o-mini"),
        Preset("OpenRouter", "https://openrouter.ai/api/v1", "anthropic/claude-sonnet-4.5"),
        Preset("Groq", "https://api.groq.com/openai/v1", "llama-3.3-70b-versatile"),
    )

    data class Config(
        val baseUrl: String = DEFAULT_BASE_URL,
        val apiKey: String = "",
        val model: String = DEFAULT_MODEL,
        val githubToken: String = "",
        val confirmMode: String = MODE_AUTO,
        val maxSteps: Int = DEFAULT_MAX_STEPS,
    ) {
        /**
         * The API key is optional: local servers (llama.cpp, vLLM) need none,
         * and for Zen the server itself answers 403 without one — which the
         * agent surfaces with a hint. Only URL and model are required.
         */
        val isReady: Boolean get() = baseUrl.isNotBlank() && model.isNotBlank()
        val endpoint: String get() = baseUrl.trimEnd('/') + "/chat/completions"
        val isZen: Boolean get() = baseUrl.contains("opencode.ai/zen")
        val hasGitHub: Boolean get() = githubToken.isNotBlank()
        val safeMaxSteps: Int get() = maxSteps.coerceIn(1, MAX_STEPS_LIMIT)
    }

    private const val PREFS = "agent"

    fun read(context: Context): Config {
        val prefs = context.getSharedPreferences(PREFS, Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
        return Config(
            baseUrl = prefs.getString("baseUrl", DEFAULT_BASE_URL)!!.trim().trimEnd('/').ifBlank { DEFAULT_BASE_URL },
            apiKey = prefs.getString("apiKey", "")!!.trim(),
            model = prefs.getString("model", DEFAULT_MODEL)!!.trim().ifBlank { DEFAULT_MODEL },
            githubToken = prefs.getString("githubToken", "")!!.trim(),
            confirmMode = prefs.getString("confirmMode", MODE_AUTO)!!.trim().let { if (it in MODES) it else MODE_AUTO },
            maxSteps = prefs.getString("maxSteps", DEFAULT_MAX_STEPS.toString())!!.trim().toIntOrNull() ?: DEFAULT_MAX_STEPS,
        )
    }

    fun save(context: Context, config: Config) {
        context.getSharedPreferences(PREFS, Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
            .edit()
            .putString("baseUrl", config.baseUrl.trim().trimEnd('/'))
            .putString("apiKey", config.apiKey.trim())
            .putString("model", config.model.trim())
            .putString("githubToken", config.githubToken.trim())
            .putString("confirmMode", config.confirmMode)
            .putString("maxSteps", config.safeMaxSteps.toString())
            .apply()
    }

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------- ui state

    /**
     * Which session tab was active and which tabs were open, so the agent
     * chat comes back exactly as it was after the app is closed. Returns null
     * when nothing was saved yet (first launch → continue the latest session).
     */
    data class UiState(val lastSessionId: String?, val openTabs: List<String>)

    fun readUiState(context: Context): UiState? {
        val prefs = context.getSharedPreferences(PREFS, Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
        if (!prefs.contains("uiOpenTabs")) return null
        val last = prefs.getString("uiLastSessionId", "")!!.takeIf { it.isNotBlank() }
        val tabs = prefs.getString("uiOpenTabs", "")!!.split(',').filter { it.isNotBlank() }
        return UiState(last, tabs)
    }

    fun saveUiState(context: Context, lastSessionId: String?, openTabs: List<String>) {
        context.getSharedPreferences(PREFS, Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
            .edit()
            .putString("uiLastSessionId", lastSessionId ?: "")
            .putString("uiOpenTabs", openTabs.joinToString(","))
            .apply()
    }
}

--- android/app/src/main/java/dev/pocketrun/agent/opencode/Commands.kt	
+++ android/app/src/main/java/dev/pocketrun/agent/opencode/Commands.kt	
@@ -0,0 +1,53 @@
+package dev.pocketrun.agent.opencode
+
+import java.io.File
+
+/**
+ * Custom slash commands from `opencode.json` (`command` block) and
+ * `.opencode/command/<name>.md`. Expanding a template applies the same substitutions
+ * opencode does: `$ARGUMENTS`, positional `$1`…`$9`, and `@path` file includes.
+ */
+object Commands {
+
+    /** Splits "/name the rest" into (name, args). Null when not a slash line. */
+    fun parse(input: String): Pair<String, String>? {
+        val text = input.trim()
+        if (!text.startsWith("/")) return null
+        val body = text.substring(1)
+        val name = body.substringBefore(' ').trim()
+        if (name.isEmpty()) return null
+        val args = body.substringAfter(' ', "").trim()
+        return name to args
+    }
+
+    /**
+     * The prompt text a command expands to. [baseDir] anchors `@file` lookups;
+     * a missing file stays as a short note instead of failing the whole call.
+     */
+    fun expand(command: OpenCodeConfig.CommandDef, args: String, baseDir: File?): String {
+        val positional = if (args.isBlank()) emptyList() else args.split(Regex("\\s+"))
+        var text = command.template
+        for (i in 9 downTo 1) {
+            text = text.replace("\$$i", positional.getOrElse(i - 1) { "" })
+        }
+        text = text.replace("\$ARGUMENTS", args)
+        text = expandFileMentions(text, baseDir)
+        return text.trim()
+    }
+
+    private val mention = Regex("@([\\w./\\-]+)")
+
+    private fun expandFileMentions(text: String, baseDir: File?): String {
+        if (baseDir == null) return text
+        return mention.replace(text) { m ->
+            val path = m.groupValues[1]
+            val file = File(baseDir, path)
+            if (file.isFile && file.canonicalPath.startsWith(baseDir.canonicalPath)) {
+                val body = runCatching { file.readText(Charsets.UTF_8) }.getOrDefault("")
+                "```$path\n${body.take(16 * 1024)}\n```"
+            } else {
+                m.value
+            }
+        }
+    }
+}

     /** Executes one tool call; never throws — errors come back as text. */
     fun execute(name: String, argsJson: String): String {
         return try {
             if (!permitted(name)) return "error: инструмент '$name' недоступен этому агенту"
             val args = JSONObject(argsJson.ifBlank { "{}" })
             // Permission gate: opencode.json / agent rules decide allow/ask/deny.
             // Without a resolver, the old rule stands — mutating tools ask the UI
             // approver (set in manual mode), reads run freely.
             val decision = permissionResolver?.invoke(name, argsJson)
                 ?: if (isReadOnly(name, args)) OpenCodeConfig.Permission.ALLOW
                 else if (toolApprover != null) OpenCodeConfig.Permission.ASK
                 else OpenCodeConfig.Permission.ALLOW
             when (decision) {
                 OpenCodeConfig.Permission.DENY -> return "(запрещено настройками: $name)"
                 OpenCodeConfig.Permission.ASK -> {
                     val approver = toolApprover
                         ?: return "(нужно подтверждение для $name — включите режим «Вручную» или разрешите инструмент в opencode.json)"
                     if (!approver(name, argsJson)) return "(отклонено пользователем)"
                 }
                 OpenCodeConfig.Permission.ALLOW -> Unit
             }
             when (name) {
                 "bash" -> doBash(args)
                 "read" -> doRead(args)
                 "write" -> doWrite(args)
                 "edit" -> doEdit(args)
                 "list" -> doList(args)
                 "glob" -> doGlob(args)
                 "grep" -> doGrep(args)
                 "apply_patch" -> doApplyPatch(args)
                 "todowrite" -> doTodoWrite(args)
                 "webfetch" -> doWebFetch(args)
                 "skill" -> doSkill(args)
                 "question" -> doQuestion(args)
                 "github" -> doGitHub(args)
                 "task" -> doTask(args)
                 else -> "unknown tool: $name"
             }
         } catch (t: Throwable) {
             "error: ${t.message ?: t.javaClass.simpleName}"
         }
     }
 
     /** True when the call cannot change anything (auto-approved in manual mode). */
     fun isReadOnly(name: String, args: JSONObject): Boolean = when (name) {
         "read", "list", "glob", "grep", "webfetch", "skill", "question", "todowrite" -> true
         "github" -> args.optString("op") in GitHubClient.READ_OPS
         else -> false
     }

     private fun doBash(args: JSONObject): String {
         val command = args.getString("command")
         val timeout = args.optLong("timeout", BASH_TIMEOUT_MS).coerceIn(1_000, BASH_TIMEOUT_MS)
         val r = shell.execute(command, base(), timeout)
         val out = buildString {
             append("exit code: ").append(r.exitCode).append('\n')
             if (r.output.isNotBlank()) append(r.output.trimEnd()).append('\n')
         }
         return out.trim().take(MAX_TOOL_OUTPUT)
     }
 
     private fun doRead(args: JSONObject): String {
         val f = resolve(args.getString("filePath")) ?: return "error: путь вне песочницы"
         if (!f.exists()) return "error: файл не найден: ${args.getString("filePath")}"
         if (f.isDirectory) return "error: это каталог, используйте list"
         val text = f.readText(Charsets.UTF_8)
         val offset = args.optInt("offset", 1).coerceAtLeast(1)
         val limit = args.optInt("limit", 0)
         val lines = text.lines()
         val from = (offset - 1).coerceIn(0, lines.size)
         val to = if (limit > 0) minOf(from + limit, lines.size) else lines.size
         val picked = lines.subList(from, to)
         val body = picked.joinToString("\n")
         return (body.take(MAX_READ) + if (body.length > MAX_READ) "\n… (обрезано)" else "")
             .ifEmpty { "(пустой файл)" }
     }

     private fun doEdit(args: JSONObject): String {
         val f = resolve(args.getString("filePath")) ?: return "error: путь вне песочницы"
         if (!f.isFile) return "error: файл не найден: ${args.getString("filePath")}"
         val old = args.getString("oldString")
         val new = args.optString("newString", "")
         if (old.isEmpty()) return "error: oldString пуст"
         val text = f.readText(Charsets.UTF_8)
         val count = countOccurrences(text, old)

         if (count > 1 && !args.optBoolean("replaceAll", false)) {
             return "error: oldString встречается $count раз — уточните текст или передайте replaceAll: true"
         }
         val updated = if (args.optBoolean("replaceAll", false)) text.replace(old, new) else text.replaceFirst(old, new)
+        onBeforeWrite?.invoke(f)
         f.writeText(updated, Charsets.UTF_8)
         return "ok: заменено вхождений: ${if (args.optBoolean("replaceAll", false)) count else 1}"
     }
 
     private fun doList(args: JSONObject): String {
         val path = args.optString("path", ".")
         val dir = resolve(path) ?: return "error: путь вне песочницы"
         if (!dir.exists()) return "error: нет такого каталога: $path"
         if (!dir.isDirectory) return "error: не каталог: $path"
         val entries = dir.listFiles()?.sortedWith(compareByDescending<File> { it.isDirectory }.thenBy { it.name }) ?: return "(empty)"
         if (entries.isEmpty()) return "(empty)"
         return entries.take(200).joinToString("\n") { f -> if (f.isDirectory) f.name + "/" else f.name + " (${f.length()} bytes)" }
     }
 
     private fun doGlob(args: JSONObject): String {
         val pattern = args.getString("pattern")
         val dir = resolve(args.optString("path", ".")) ?: return "error: путь вне песочницы"
         val base = dir.takeIf { it.isDirectory } ?: workspace.root
         val matches = mutableListOf<File>()
         base.walkTopDown().forEach { f ->
             if (f.isFile) {
                 val rel = f.relativeToOrNull(base)?.path ?: return@forEach
                 if (globToRegex(pattern).matches(rel)) matches += f
             }
         }
         if (matches.isEmpty()) return "(нет совпадений)"
         return matches.sortedByDescending { it.lastModified() }
             .take(200)
             .joinToString("\n") { workspace.relativeTo(it) }
     }
 
     private fun doGrep(args: JSONObject): String {
         val pattern = try { Regex(args.getString("pattern")) } catch (t: Throwable) { return "error: плохой regex: ${t.message}" }
         val dir = resolve(args.optString("path", ".")) ?: return "error: путь вне песочницы"
         val base = dir.takeIf { it.isDirectory } ?: workspace.root
         val include = args.optString("include").takeIf { it.isNotBlank() }?.let { globToRegex(it) }
         val out = StringBuilder()
         base.walkTopDown().forEach { f ->
             if (out.length > MAX_TOOL_OUTPUT) return@forEach
             if (!f.isFile || f.length() > 512 * 1024) return@forEach
             val rel = workspace.relativeTo(f)
             if (include != null && !include.matches(f.name) && !include.matches(rel)) return@forEach
             val text = runCatching { f.readText(Charsets.UTF_8) }.getOrNull() ?: return@forEach
             text.lines().forEachIndexed { idx, line ->
                 if (pattern.containsMatchIn(line)) out.append("$rel:${idx + 1}: ${line.take(300)}\n")
             }
         }
         return out.toString().trim().take(MAX_TOOL_OUTPUT).ifEmpty { "(нет совпадений)" }
     }

     private fun doTodoWrite(args: JSONObject): String {

         val list = mutableListOf<Sessions.Todo>()
         for (i in 0 until arr.length()) {

     private fun doWebFetch(args: JSONObject): String {
         val url = args.getString("url")
         if (!url.startsWith("http://") && !url.startsWith("https://")) return "error: только http(s) URL"
         return try {
             val conn = URL(url).openConnection() as HttpURLConnection
             conn.connectTimeout = 10_000
             conn.readTimeout = 30_000
             conn.instanceFollowRedirects = true
             conn.setRequestProperty("User-Agent", "Mozilla/5.0 (compatible; PocketRunAgent/1.3)")
             val status = conn.responseCode
             val body = (if (status in 200..299) conn.inputStream else conn.errorStream)
                 ?.bufferedReader(Charsets.UTF_8)?.use { it.readText() } ?: ""
             if (status !in 200..299) return "HTTP $status: ${body.take(300)}"
             val text = stripHtml(body)
             text.take(MAX_WEB).ifEmpty { "(пустой ответ)" }
         } catch (t: Throwable) {
             "error: ${t.message ?: t.javaClass.simpleName}"
         }
     }

             questions += Question(

                 question = o.optString("question").ifEmpty { "Вопрос" },
                 options = (0 until opts.length()).map { opts.optString(it) },
             )
         }
         if (questions.isEmpty()) return "error: нет вопросов"
         val asker = questionAsker ?: return "(вопросы недоступны в этом режиме)"
         return asker(questions)
     }

                 "runs" -> gh.runs(args.getString("repo"), args.optInt("limit", 10))
                 "run_wait" -> gh.runWait(
                     repo = args.getString("repo"),
                     runId = args.optLong("run_id", 0).takeIf { it != 0L },
                     timeoutSec = args.optInt("timeout_sec", 600),
                     isCancelled = { cancelCheck?.invoke() == true },
                 )
                 "run_cancel" -> gh.runCancel(args.getString("repo"), args.getLong("run_id"))
                 "logs" -> gh.logs(args.getString("repo"), args.getLong("run_id"))
                 "artifacts" -> gh.artifacts(args.getString("repo"), args.optLong("run_id", 0).takeIf { it != 0L })
                 "artifact_download" -> gh.artifactDownload(args.getString("repo"), args.getLong("artifact_id"))
                 "api" -> gh.api(args.optString("method", "GET"), args.getString("api_path"), args.optString("body").takeIf { it.isNotEmpty() })
                 else -> "error: неизвестная операция '$op' (me, repo_list, repo_create, push, file_delete, file_get, workflow_create, dispatch, runs, run_wait, run_cancel, logs, artifacts, artifact_download, api)"
             }
         } catch (e: GitHubClient.GitHubException) {
             "error: ${e.message}"
         }
     }
 
     // ---------------------------------------------------------------- helpers
 
     private fun resolve(path: String): File? = workspace.resolve(path, base())
 
     private fun countOccurrences(text: String, needle: String): Int {
         var count = 0
         var idx = 0
         while (true) {
             idx = text.indexOf(needle, idx)
             if (idx < 0) return count
             count++
             idx += needle.length
         }
     }
 
     private fun globToRegex(pattern: String): Regex {
         val regex = buildString {
             append('^')
             var i = 0
             while (i < pattern.length) {
                 when (val c = pattern[i]) {
                     '*' -> if (i + 1 < pattern.length && pattern[i + 1] == '*') { append(".*"); i++ } else append("[^/]*")
                     '?' -> append('.')
                     else -> if (c in "\\^$.|+()[]{}") { append('\\'); append(c) } else append(c)
                 }
                 i++
             }
             append('$')
         }
         return Regex(regex)
     }
 
     private fun stripHtml(html: String): String {
         return html
             .replace(Regex("(?is)<(script|style)[^>]*>.*?</\\1>"), " ")
             .replace(Regex("(?s)<!--.*?-->"), " ")
             .replace(Regex("(?s)<br[^>]*>|</p>|</div>|</li>"), "\n")
             .replace(Regex("(?s)<[^>]+>"), " ")
             .replace(" ", " ").replace("&", "&").replace("<", "<")
             .replace(">", ">").replace(""", "\"").replace("'", "'")
             .replace(Regex("[ \\t\\x0B\\f\\r]+"), " ")
             .replace(Regex("\\n\\s*\\n+"), "\n")
             .trim()
     }
 }

+    @Test

 # PocketRun — статус, архитектура и что осталось сделать
 
 Дата: 26 сентября 2026
 Репозиторий: `sj0404-collab/pocketrun` (приватный)
 CI: `.github/workflows/android.yml` — сборка APK и тесты в GitHub Actions, локальная сборка не нужна.
 
 ---
 
 ## 1. Что это
 
 Упрощённый оригинал (не аналог того, что есть в маркетплейсах) — Android-приложение
 на Kotlin, внутри которого живут:
 
 | Слой | Реализация | Состояние |
 |---|---|---|
 | Python | настоящий CPython 3.13 через Chaquopy | бутстрап + Kotlin-мост `PythonRuntime` готовы |
 | Node.js | настоящий Node 18 (nodejs-mobile) + Rhino-фолбэк | готово |
 | npx | свой: реестр npm + распаковка tar + запуск `bin` | не начато |
 | opencode | инструменты, навыки, сессии и инструкции opencode-стиля (v1.3.0) | готово |
 | Релиз-ключ | Ed25519, офлайн-проверка, утилита keygen | **готово** |
 | Интерфейс | Jetpack Compose | MVP: активация → проекты → редактор+терминал → инфо |
 
 Ключевое ограничение, определившее архитектуру: **это Android без Termux**, то есть
 нет Linux-пространства пользователя. Отсюда решения ниже.
 
 ---
 
 ## 2. Ключевые технические решения
 
 ### 2.1 Node.js: настоящий Node 18, Rhino как фолбэк
 
 `nodejs-mobile` даёт настоящий Node 18 в виде `libnode.so` (~62 МБ на ABI), но
 без исполняемого файла. Android API 29+ запрещает запускать файлы из каталога
 данных приложения, поэтому:
 
 * берём `libnode.so` из релиза nodejs-mobile v18.20.4 (arm64-v8a, x86_64);
 * собираем лаунчер `cpp/noderunner.cpp` (`node::Start(argc, argv)`), линкуем
   NDK clang'ом и упаковываем как `libnoderunner.so` прямо в `jniLibs` — Android
   извлекает `lib*.so` в `nativeLibraryDir`, откуда их можно exec'нуть;
 * `packaging.jniLibs.useLegacyPackaging = true`, иначе библиотеки не
   распакуются из APK и исполняемого файла на диске не будет;
 * `runtime/js/NodeRuntime.kt` запускает `libnoderunner.so` через
   `ProcessBuilder` на каждый скрипт: настоящий изолированный и отменяемый
   процесс; `LD_LIBRARY_PATH`, `NODE_PATH` и cwd пробрасываются.
 
 Загрузка и сборка — Gradle-задачи `fetchNodeMobile` и `assembleNodeJniLibs`
 (кэш в `android/.nodejs-mobile`). Rhino + `assets/node/boot.js` остаются
 фолбэком, когда нативный лаунчер недоступен (например, JVM-тесты). APK растёт
 примерно вдвое.
 
 ### 2.2 Python
 
 Chaquopy 17.0.0 (плагин), CPython 3.13. Версия Python выбирается блоком
 `chaquopy { defaultConfig { version = "3.13" } }` в `android/app/build.gradle.kts`;
 зависимость `com.chaquo.python:python` для этого не работает — Chaquopy 17 её
 игнорирует и молча собирает дефолтный 3.10 (так было до сентября 2026).
 Плагин не публикует marker-артефакт, поэтому в `settings.gradle.kts` есть
 `resolutionStrategy.eachPlugin` с `useModule("com.chaquo.python:gradle:...")`.
 
 Пакеты Python ставятся на этапе сборки, а не во время работы:
 
 ```kotlin
 // android/app/build.gradle.kts
 chaquopy {
     defaultConfig { /* ... */ }
 }
 dependencies { /* ... */ }
 // pip { install("requests") }
 ```
 
 Предупреждение сборки `Failed to compile to .pyc format: Couldn't find Python 3.10`
 безвредно: на машине сборки нет CPython 3.10, Chaquopy просто не предкомпилирует
 *.pyc* и интерпретирует исходники. На устройство это не влияет. С сентября 2026 в CI
 стоит `actions/setup-python` с 3.13, совпадающим с версией приложения, поэтому
 *.pyc* компилируется и это предупреждение ушло.
 
 ### 2.3 Формат лицензионного ключа
 
 Ключ выглядит так:
 
 ```
 PRK1.<base64url(payload)>.<base64url(ed25519-подпись)>
 ```
 
 `payload` — канонический текстовый документ (не JSON, чтобы подпись была
 побитово воспроизводимой):
 
 ```
 PRK1
 name=Jane Doe
 seat=work-laptop
 plan=pro
 nbf=1750000000
 exp=1760000000
 ```
 
 Подпись покрывает **байты payload**, а не пересериализованный объект. Поэтому
 проверка идёт в строгом порядке: разделить ключ → проверить подпись по байтам →
 только потом парсить поля.
 
 Отслеживания нет: срок задаётся в ключе, отзыв невозможен by design. Смена
 параметров — это смена встроенного в APK публичного ключа.
 
 Публичный ключ вшивается в сборку из `android/license.pubkey`:
 
 ```
 ./tools/keygen/gradlew -p tools/keygen run --args="genkey --out android"
 ```
 
 Если файла нет, в APK попадает заглушка `DEMO…`, и приложение честно отказывает
 любому ключу с сообщением об этом.
 
 ### 2.4 Две разные вещи под словом «релиз-ключ»
 
 1. **Ключ активации** — лицензия пользователя, проверяется офлайн (выше).
 2. **Ключ подписи APK** — `android/keystore.properties` + `release` signingConfig.
    Без него `packageRelease` падает с понятной ошибкой. В CI подпись берётся из
    секретов `ANDROID_KEYSTORE_B64` / `_PASSWORD` / `KEY_ALIAS` / `KEY_PASSWORD`;
    если секретов нет, собирается только debug APK.
 
 ### 2.5 Вывод в терминал
 
 Рантаймы не пишут в stdout процесса. Они пишут в два файла в
 `workspace/cache/runs/<id>/`, а `OutputTailer` следит за ними и отдаёт строки
 в UI. Причины: пайп блокирует интерпретатор при медленном читателе, файл
 переживает падение UI, и stderr можно красить отдельно. Декодирование
 инкрементальное — многобайтный UTF-8 не рвётся на границе буфера.
 
 ### 2.6 Границы песочницы
 
 `core/Workspace.kt` — единственное место, где живут пути. Корень:
 `filesDir/workspace`. Внутри: `projects/`, `packages/`, `cache/`, `logs/`.
 `Workspace.resolve()` возвращает `null`, если путь уходит наружу; вызывающий код
 трактует это как «путь отклонён», а не «файла нет».
 
 ---
 
 ## 3. Что уже написано
 
 ```
 android/app/src/main/java/dev/pocketrun/
   MainActivity.kt                     заглушка
   core/Workspace.kt                   песочница, защита от выхода за корень
   license/LicenseFormat.kt            формат ключа (копия в tools/keygen)
   license/Ed25519.kt                  чистая Java Ed25519 для API 26+
   license/LicenseVerifier.kt          чистая проверка ключа: подпись + окно времени
   license/LicenseManager.kt           SharedPreferences + StateFlow, фичи по плану
   runtime/Exec.kt                     модель выполнения, интерфейс рантайма
   runtime/OutputTailer.kt             живой вывод из файлов
 android/app/src/main/python/
   pocketrun.py                        argv, sys.path, потоки, трейсбеки, пакеты
 android/app/src/test/java/dev/pocketrun/license/
   LicenseFormatTest.kt                золотой тест-вектор, общий с keygen
 tools/keygen/                         отдельный JVM-проект: genkey/issue/verify/inspect
 .github/workflows/android.yml         сборка APK + тесты в GitHub
 ```
 
 Тест-вектор (детерминированный сид → фиксированный ключ) зафиксирован в обоих
 проектах: `tools/keygen/.../LicenseFormatTest.kt` и
 `android/app/src/test/.../LicenseFormatTest.kt`. Расхождение формата валит одну
 из сборок.
 
 ---
 
 ## 4. Что осталось
 
 Порядок именно такой — каждый пункт опирается на предыдущий.
 
 ### 4.1 Python-мост (следующий шаг) ✅ готово (v1.1.0)
 
 `runtime/python/PythonRuntime.kt`:
 * `initAsync()` стартует `Python.start(AndroidPlatform(context))` один раз, из
   `PocketRunApplication.onCreate` на фоновом потоке — старт занимает около секунды;
 * `execute()` создаёт `out_path`/`err_path` в `workspace/cache/runs/<id>`,
   поднимает два `OutputTailer`, вызывает `pocketrun.run(script, argsJson, stdin,
   out, err, cwd)`, возвращает `ExecResult`;
 * `isAvailable()` и `version()` читаются из `pocketrun.interpreter_info()`;
 * **ограничение отмены:** Chaquopy не умеет прерывать вызов. `cancel()` ставит
   флаг, и по возвращению выдаётся код 130. Убийство процесса невозможно —
   это честно показано в UI.
 
 ### 4.2 Node ✅ готово: настоящий Node 18 + Rhino-фолбэк
 
 Нативный Node (основной путь на устройстве):
 
 * `cpp/noderunner.cpp` + Gradle-задачи `fetchNodeMobile` /
   `assembleNodeJniLibs` в `android/app/build.gradle.kts` — скачивают
   nodejs-mobile v18.20.4, собирают `libnoderunner.so` под arm64-v8a и x86_64 и
   кладут рядом `libnode.so` и NDK-ный `libc++_shared.so`;
 * `runtime/js/NodeRuntime.kt` (`SyncScriptRuntime`) — `ProcessBuilder` на
   каждый запуск, реальные stdout/stderr, отмена через `destroy()`, таймаут →
   код 124; `AppViewModel.activeNode` выбирает его, когда лаунчер есть, иначе
   падает на Rhino; `MiniShell`, `NpxRuntime` и `OpenCodeTools` работают через
   интерфейс `SyncScriptRuntime`.
 
 Rhino-фолбэк (когда нативного лаунчера нет, например в JVM-тестах):
 
 * `runtime/js/JsRuntime.kt` — Rhino 1.8.1 `Context` (`VERSION_ES6`,
   `setOptimizationLevel(-1)`, `initSafeStandardObjects`), мост `__pr` на
   BaseFunction-подклассах (Kotlin null → JS null, не undefined!), event loop
   по хукам `__prRunDue/__prPending/__prNextDue/__prExitCode/__prOnExit`,
   вывод через log-файлы и OutputTailer как у Python, отмена → код 130;
 * `assets/node/boot.js` — `require` (relative/json/`node_modules`/`packages/`,
   `__dirname`, `__setMainDir` для главного скрипта), `module.exports`,
   `path`, `process`, `console`, `os`, `util`, `events`, `url`/`querystring`,
   `http(s)` (синхронный через мост, фейк-асинхронный API), `assert`,
   `stream` (Readable/Writable/Duplex/Transform/PassThrough с буферизацией,
   `pipe`, `drain`/`finish`/`end`), таймеры, `Buffer` (utf8/base64/hex,
   кириллица), полифилл `Promise`;
 * `os`/`process` отдают живые данные устройства через мост
   (`core/SystemInfo.kt`): `arch`/`release`/`hostname`/`cpus`/`totalmem`/
   `freemem`/`uptime`/`loadavg`/`networkInterfaces` (из `/proc` и `java.net`),
   `process.memoryUsage()`/`hrtime()`/`pid`; `fs.createReadStream` и
   `fs.createWriteStream` — настоящие потоки, а не заглушки;

 Экраны: активация → список проектов → редактор + терминал → чат агента →

 * `AppViewModel.SessionRun` — состояние одного хода (сообщения, todos,

 Всё собирается в CI, локальный Android SDK не нужен:
 
 ```bash
 gh run watch
 gh run download --name pocketrun-apk
 ```
 
 Только лицензионная логика (JVM, без Android):
 
 ```bash
 tools/keygen/gradlew -p tools/keygen test
 android/gradlew -p android :app:testDebugUnitTest
 ```

 tools/keygen/gradlew -p tools/keygen run --args="issue --name 'Jane Doe' --seat laptop --plan pro --days 30"

9: /**
10:  * The opencode agent loop: user message in, tool calls out, tool results back
11:  * in, repeat until a plain-text answer (or the round budget). The system prompt
12:  * is assembled opencode-style: base agent prompt + AGENTS.md instructions +
13:  * current todos; skills are advertised through the `skill` tool description.
14:  *

16:  * them: the answer is streamed (so the connection never goes idle and ⏹ works),
17:  * the history is trimmed before every request (so the prompt stays inside the
18:  * model's context), and a turn that runs out of rounds is saved instead of lost
19:  * — the user continues it with `/continue`.
20:  */
21: class OpenCodeAgent(
22:     private val workspace: Workspace,
23:     private val tools: OpenCodeTools,
24:     private val clientFactory: () -> LlmClient,
25:     private val projectDir: File?,
26:     private val maxSteps: Int = 12,
27:     private val askMode: Boolean = false,
28:     private val hasGitHub: Boolean = false,
29:     /** Polled before every request and between tool calls: this is what ⏹ does. */
30:     private val isCancelled: () -> Boolean = { false },
31:     /** When set, this run is a `task` subagent of the given type (explore/general). */
32:     private val subagentType: String? = null,
33:     private val maxHistoryChars: Int = HistoryTrimmer.DEFAULT_MAX_CHARS,
34: ) {
35: 
36:     sealed class Event {
37:         /** A new model round has started (1-based, with the budget). */
38:         data class Round(val step: Int, val maxSteps: Int) : Event()
39:         /** The model is streaming an answer; [preview] is what it has written so far. */
40:         data class Thinking(val preview: String) : Event()
41:         data class AssistantText(val text: String) : Event()
42:         data class ToolStart(val name: String, val args: String) : Event()
43:         data class ToolDone(val name: String, val result: String) : Event()
44:         /** Something worth telling the user without failing the turn (a retry, a trim). */
45:         data class Note(val text: String) : Event()
46:         data class Failed(val message: String) : Event()
47:     }
48: 
49:     companion object {
50:         const val CANCELLED = "остановлено пользователем"
51: 
52:         /** Sent when the model answers with nothing at all. */
53:         const val CONTINUE_NUDGE =
54:             "Your previous answer was empty. Continue the task, then finish with a short summary of what you did."
55: 
56:         /** Sent by the `/continue` chat command. */
57:         const val CONTINUE_PROMPT = "Продолжай с того места, где остановился."
58:     }

60:     /**
61:      * Runs one user turn against [messages] (the session history WITHOUT the
62:      * system message) and returns the extended history.
63:      */
64:     fun run(userText: String, messages: JSONArray, onEvent: (Event) -> Unit): JSONArray {
65:         val full = JSONArray()
66:         full.put(systemMessage())
67:         for (i in 0 until messages.length()) full.put(messages.get(i))
68:         if (userText.isNotBlank()) {

70:         }

73:         var trimmed = false
74:         try {

76:                 if (isCancelled()) {

78:                     break
79:                 }

81:                 onEvent(Event.Round(maxSteps - budget, maxSteps))
82: 
83:                 // Keep the prompt inside the model's context: old tool output is
84:                 // excerpted and, if needed, old rounds are dropped.
85:                 val request = HistoryTrimmer.trim(full, maxHistoryChars)
86:                 if (request !== full && !trimmed) {

93:                 val response = try {

96:                         val now = System.currentTimeMillis()
97:                         if (now - lastEmit > 400) {

99:                             onEvent(Event.Thinking(preview.toString()))

102:                 } finally {

106:                 if (response.toolCalls.isEmpty() && response.content.isNullOrBlank()) {

109:                     full.put(JSONObject().put("role", "assistant").put("content", "(пустой ответ)"))

112:                 }
113: 
114:                 if (response.toolCalls.isEmpty()) {

display.text:
name: Release

# A tag is the release: v1.5.0 builds the APKs, runs the same tests as the
# Android workflow, and publishes them as a GitHub release. The app reads
# /releases/latest to find out what is new, so publishing here is what makes an
# update show up on a phone.
#
# The APKs are named PocketRun-<tag>-release.apk / -debug.apk, which is what
# dev.pocketrun.update.AppUpdate looks for.

on:
  push:
    tags: ["v*"]
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      tag:
        description: "Existing tag to publish (e.g. v1.5.0); empty = the pushed tag"
        required: false
        default: ""

permissions:
  contents: write

concurrency:
  group: release-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  release:
    name: Build and publish
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 60
    env:
      TAG: ${{ inputs.tag || github.ref_name }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v5
        with:
          ref: ${{ inputs.tag || github.ref }}
          fetch-depth: 0
          # versionCode/versionName come from the nearest tag, and a checkout of
          # a ref does not fetch tags even at depth 0.
          fetch-tags: true

      - uses: actions/setup-java@v5
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: "17"

      # Chaquopy needs a build machine Python matching the app's major.minor.
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.13"

      - uses: gradle/actions/setup-gradle@v4

      - name: Cache Chaquopy + nodejs-mobile downloads
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.chaquopy
            ~/.gradle/caches/modules-2
            android/.nodejs-mobile
            android/.busybox
          key: chaquopy-${{ hashFiles('android/app/build.gradle.kts') }}
          restore-keys: chaquopy-

      - name: Unit tests
        working-directory: android
        run: ./gradlew --no-daemon :app:testDebugUnitTest

      - name: Python sandbox tests
        run: python3 -m unittest discover -s android/app/src/test/python -v

      - name: Assemble release APK
        env:
          KEYSTORE_B64: ${{ secrets.ANDROID_KEYSTORE_B64 }}
          KEYSTORE_PASS: ${{ secrets.ANDROID_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD }}
          KEY_ALIAS: ${{ secrets.ANDROID_KEY_ALIAS }}
          KEY_PASS: ${{ secrets.ANDROID_KEY_PASSWORD }}
        # No working-directory here on purpose: the keystore lands in android/
        # (the Gradle rootProject) and gradlew is invoked from android/.
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          if [ -z "${KEYSTORE_B64:-}" ]; then
            echo "::error title=no signing key::ANDROID_KEYSTORE_B64 is not configured; a release without a signature is not an update."
            exit 1
          fi
          printf '%s' "$KEYSTORE_B64" | base64 -d > android/keystore.jks
          cat > android/keystore.properties <<EOF
          storeFile=keystore.jks
          storePassword=$KEYSTORE_PASS
          keyAlias=$KEY_ALIAS
          keyPassword=$KEY_PASS
          EOF
          cd android && ./gradlew --no-daemon :app:assembleRelease :app:assembleDebug

      - name: Name the assets
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir -p dist
          cp android/app/build/outputs/apk/release/*.apk "dist/PocketRun-${TAG}-release.apk"
          cp android/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/*.apk "dist/PocketRun-${TAG}-debug.apk"
          ls -la dist

      - name: Publish the release
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          NOTES=$(cat <<'EOF'
          Ключ активации в этот раз не нужен: сборка активируется общим ключом,
          который лежит внутри APK (android/shared-license.key). Он открыт по
          определению — тот, у кого есть файл, может его прочитать, — так что
          лицензия здесь формальность, а не защита.

          Обновления приходят сами: приложение раз в сутки спрашивает GitHub про
          последний релиз и предлагает установить его (вкладка «Инфо» → «Обновления»).
          EOF
          )
          if gh release view "$TAG" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            echo "releasing $TAG (replacing the assets of an existing release)"
            gh release upload "$TAG" dist/*.apk --clobber
          else
            gh release create "$TAG" dist/*.apk \
              --title "PocketRun $TAG" \
              --notes "$NOTES" \
              --generate-notes
          fi

      - name: Build report
        run: |
          echo "### PocketRun $TAG" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          ls -la dist >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

+package dev.pocketrun.agent.opencode
+
+import org.json.JSONObject
+import java.io.File
+import java.net.HttpURLConnection
+import java.net.URL
+
+/**
+ * A small client for the public models.dev catalog (https://models.dev/api.json):
+ * the same source opencode uses to know which providers and models exist, with
+ * their capabilities. The catalog is a few megabytes, so it is fetched on
+ * demand, cached for a day, and parsed lazily into a compact list.
+ */
+object ModelsDev {
+
+    const val URL = "https://models.dev/api.json"
+    private const val MAX_BYTES = 8 * 1024 * 1024
+    private const val MAX_AGE_MS = 24L * 60 * 60 * 1000
+
+    data class ModelInfo(
+        val id: String,
+        val name: String,
+        val reasoning: Boolean,
+        val toolCall: Boolean,
+        val attachment: Boolean,
+    )
+
+    data class ProviderInfo(val id: String, val name: String, val models: List<ModelInfo>)
+
+    /** Returns the catalog, using [cacheDir] as a one-day cache. Empty on failure. */
+    fun load(cacheDir: File): Map<String, ProviderInfo> {
+        val cache = File(cacheDir, "models-dev.json")
+        val fresh = cache.isFile && System.currentTimeMillis() - cache.lastModified() < MAX_AGE_MS
+        val text = if (fresh) runCatching { cache.readText(Charsets.UTF_8) }.getOrNull()
+        else download()?.also { body -> runCatching { cache.parentFile?.mkdirs(); cache.writeText(body, Charsets.UTF_8) } }
+            ?: runCatching { cache.readText(Charsets.UTF_8) }.getOrNull()
+        return parse(text ?: return emptyMap())
+    }
+
+    private fun download(): String? = try {
+        val conn = (URL(URL).openConnection() as HttpURLConnection).apply {
+            connectTimeout = 15_000
+            readTimeout = 30_000
+            instanceFollowRedirects = true
+            setRequestProperty("User-Agent", "PocketRun/1.3")
+        }
+        val status = conn.responseCode
+        if (status !in 200..299) null
+        else conn.inputStream.bufferedReader(Charsets.UTF_8).use { r ->
+            val buf = CharArray(64 * 1024)
+            val sb = StringBuilder()
+            var n: Int
+            while (r.read(buf).also { n = it } >= 0) {
+                sb.append(buf, 0, n)
+                if (sb.length > MAX_BYTES) break
+            }
+            sb.toString()
+        }
+    } catch (t: Throwable) {
+        null
+    }
+
+    fun parse(text: String): Map<String, ProviderInfo> {
+        val root = runCatching { JSONObject(text) }.getOrNull() ?: return emptyMap()
+        val out = LinkedHashMap<String, ProviderInfo>()
+        val providers = root.keys()
+        while (providers.hasNext()) {
+            val pid = providers.next()
+            val p = root.optJSONObject(pid) ?: continue
+            val models = mutableListOf<ModelInfo>()
+            p.optJSONObject("models")?.let { m ->
+                val names = m.keys()
+                while (names.hasNext()) {
+                    val mid = names.next()
+                    val info = m.optJSONObject(mid) ?: continue
+                    models += ModelInfo(
+                        id = info.optString("id").ifBlank { mid },
+                        name = info.optString("name").ifBlank { mid },
+                        reasoning = info.optBoolean("reasoning", false),
+                        toolCall = info.optBoolean("tool_call", false),
+                        attachment = info.optBoolean("attachment", false),
+                    )
+                }
+            }
+            out[pid] = ProviderInfo(pid, p.optString("name").ifBlank { pid }, models.sortedBy { it.name.lowercase() })
+        }
+        return out
+    }
+}

     /** Executes one tool call; never throws — errors come back as text. */
     fun execute(name: String, argsJson: String): String {
         return try {
             if (!permitted(name)) return "error: инструмент '$name' недоступен этому агенту"
             val args = JSONObject(argsJson.ifBlank { "{}" })
             // Permission gate: opencode.json / agent rules decide allow/ask/deny.

             // approver (set in manual mode), reads run freely.
             val decision = permissionResolver?.invoke(name, argsJson)
                 ?: if (isReadOnly(name, args)) OpenCodeConfig.Permission.ALLOW
                 else if (toolApprover != null) OpenCodeConfig.Permission.ASK
                 else OpenCodeConfig.Permission.ALLOW
             when (decision) {
                 OpenCodeConfig.Permission.DENY -> return "(запрещено настройками: $name)"
                 OpenCodeConfig.Permission.ASK -> {
                     val approver = toolApprover
                         ?: return "(нужно подтверждение для $name — включите режим «Вручную» или разрешите инструмент в opencode.json)"
                     if (!approver(name, argsJson)) return "(отклонено пользователем)"
                 }
                 OpenCodeConfig.Permission.ALLOW -> Unit
             }
             when (name) {
                 "bash" -> doBash(args)
                 "read" -> doRead(args)
                 "write" -> doWrite(args)
                 "edit" -> doEdit(args)
                 "list" -> doList(args)
                 "glob" -> doGlob(args)
                 "grep" -> doGrep(args)
                 "apply_patch" -> doApplyPatch(args)
                 "todowrite" -> doTodoWrite(args)
+                "todoread" -> doTodoRead()
                 "webfetch" -> doWebFetch(args)
+                "websearch" -> doWebSearch(args)
                 "skill" -> doSkill(args)
                 "question" -> doQuestion(args)
                 "github" -> doGitHub(args)
                 "task" -> doTask(args)
                 else -> "unknown tool: $name"
             }
         } catch (t: Throwable) {
             "error: ${t.message ?: t.javaClass.simpleName}"
         }
     }

     private fun doWrite(args: JSONObject): String {

     private fun doEdit(args: JSONObject): String {
         val f = resolve(args.getString("filePath")) ?: return "error: путь вне песочницы"
         if (!f.isFile) return "error: файл не найден: ${args.getString("filePath")}"
         val old = args.getString("oldString")
         val new = args.optString("newString", "")
         if (old.isEmpty()) return "error: oldString пуст"
         val text = f.readText(Charsets.UTF_8)
         val count = countOccurrences(text, old)
         if (count == 0) return "error: oldString не найден в файле"
         if (count > 1 && !args.optBoolean("replaceAll", false)) {
             return "error: oldString встречается $count раз — уточните текст или передайте replaceAll: true"
         }
         val updated = if (args.optBoolean("replaceAll", false)) text.replace(old, new) else text.replaceFirst(old, new)
         onBeforeWrite?.invoke(f)
         f.writeText(updated, Charsets.UTF_8)
         return "ok: заменено вхождений: ${if (args.optBoolean("replaceAll", false)) count else 1}"
     }

     private fun doGrep(args: JSONObject): String {

         val include = args.optString("include").takeIf { it.isNotBlank() }?.let { globToRegex(it) }

         base.walkTopDown().forEach { f ->

             val rel = workspace.relativeTo(f)

         }
         return out.toString().trim().take(MAX_TOOL_OUTPUT).ifEmpty { "(нет совпадений)" }
     }

     private fun doWebFetch(args: JSONObject): String {
         val url = args.getString("url")
         if (!url.startsWith("http://") && !url.startsWith("https://")) return "error: только http(s) URL"
         return try {
             val conn = URL(url).openConnection() as HttpURLConnection
             conn.connectTimeout = 10_000
             conn.readTimeout = 30_000
             conn.instanceFollowRedirects = true
             conn.setRequestProperty("User-Agent", "Mozilla/5.0 (compatible; PocketRunAgent/1.3)")
             val status = conn.responseCode
             val body = (if (status in 200..299) conn.inputStream else conn.errorStream)
                 ?.bufferedReader(Charsets.UTF_8)?.use { it.readText() } ?: ""
             if (status !in 200..299) return "HTTP $status: ${body.take(300)}"
             val text = stripHtml(body)
             text.take(MAX_WEB).ifEmpty { "(пустой ответ)" }
         } catch (t: Throwable) {
             "error: ${t.message ?: t.javaClass.simpleName}"
         }
     }

     private fun resolve(path: String): File? = workspace.resolve(path, base())
 
     private fun countOccurrences(text: String, needle: String): Int {
         var count = 0
         var idx = 0
         while (true) {
             idx = text.indexOf(needle, idx)
             if (idx < 0) return count
             count++
             idx += needle.length
         }
     }
 
     private fun globToRegex(pattern: String): Regex {
         val regex = buildString {
             append('^')
             var i = 0
             while (i < pattern.length) {
                 when (val c = pattern[i]) {
                     '*' -> if (i + 1 < pattern.length && pattern[i + 1] == '*') { append(".*"); i++ } else append("[^/]*")
                     '?' -> append('.')
                     else -> if (c in "\\^$.|+()[]{}") { append('\\'); append(c) } else append(c)
                 }
                 i++
             }
             append('$')
         }
         return Regex(regex)
     }
 
     private fun stripHtml(html: String): String {
         return html
             .replace(Regex("(?is)<(script|style)[^>]*>.*?</\\1>"), " ")
             .replace(Regex("(?s)<!--.*?-->"), " ")
             .replace(Regex("(?s)<br[^>]*>|</p>|</div>|</li>"), "\n")
             .replace(Regex("(?s)<[^>]+>"), " ")
             .replace(" ", " ").replace("&", "&").replace("<", "<")
             .replace(">", ">").replace(""", "\"").replace("'", "'")
             .replace(Regex("[ \\t\\x0B\\f\\r]+"), " ")
             .replace(Regex("\\n\\s*\\n+"), "\n")
             .trim()
     }
 }

package dev.pocketrun.agent

import org.json.JSONArray
import org.json.JSONObject
import java.io.IOException
import java.net.HttpURLConnection
import java.net.SocketTimeoutException
import java.net.URL
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicBoolean
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicLong

/**
 * A thin OpenAI-compatible chat-completions client: POST JSON, read JSON, turn
 * the response into [Response] (text plus any tool calls).
 *
 * Three things matter for a mobile agent loop and are implemented here:
 *
 * * **Streaming.** The request asks for `stream: true` and the answer is read
 *   as SSE, so a generation that takes many minutes keeps the connection busy
 *   (idle connections get killed by gateways and mobile networks), the ⏹ button
 *   is honoured between chunks, and the UI can show what is being written. A
 *   server that answers with a plain JSON body instead is handled transparently.
 * * **Retries.** Timeouts, resets, 429 and 5xx are retried with a backoff;
 *   everything else (bad key, unknown model) fails immediately.
 * * **Long deadlines.** A model that thinks for a long time must not lose the
 *   turn: the read timeout is 15 minutes, and a watchdog aborts a connection
 *   that goes silent for much longer than that.
 */
class LlmClient(private val config: AgentSettings.Config) {

    data class ToolCall(val id: String, val name: String, val arguments: String)
    data class Response(val content: String?, val toolCalls: List<ToolCall>)

    class LlmException(message: String) : Exception(message)

    /** The server answered, but not in a form we can use — worth one plain retry. */
    private class UnusableAnswer(val detail: String) : Exception(detail)

    /** A non-2xx answer, kept structured so retries can look at the status. */
    private class HttpFailure(val status: Int, val body: String) : Exception("HTTP $status")

    companion object {
        const val CONNECT_TIMEOUT_MS = 30_000

        /** 15 minutes — a long generation must not lose the turn. */
        const val READ_TIMEOUT_MS = 900_000

        /** No bytes for this long (and none at all since the request) = dead connection. */
        const val FIRST_TOKEN_TIMEOUT_MS = 240_000

        /** A stream that goes quiet for this long after the first token is dead too. */
        const val STALL_TIMEOUT_MS = 300_000

        const val MAX_ATTEMPTS = 3
        const val RETRY_BACKOFF_MS = 3_000L
        const val CANCELLED = "остановлено пользователем"

        private const val SSE_DATA = "data:"
        private const val SSE_DONE = "[DONE]"
