private val permissions: Map<String, PermissionRule>,
    val agents: Map<String, AgentDef>,
    val commands: Map<String, CommandDef>,
) {

    enum class Permission { ALLOW, ASK, DENY }

    sealed interface PermissionRule {
        data class Simple(val permission: Permission) : PermissionRule

        /** Patterns in "most specific first" order; the first match wins. */
        data class Patterned(val entries: List<Pair<String, Permission>>) : PermissionRule
    }

    data class AgentDef(
        val name: String,
        val description: String,
        val mode: String?,
        val model: String?,
        val prompt: String?,
        val tools: Set<String>?,
        val global: Boolean,
        val file: File?,
        val temperature: Double? = null,
        val topP: Double? = null,
        val maxOutputTokens: Int? = null,
        val reasoningEffort: String? = null,
    )

    data class CommandDef(
        val name: String,
        val description: String,
        val template: String,
        val agent: String?,
        val model: String?,
        val global: Boolean,
    )

    /**
     * The configured permission for a tool call, or null when the config says
     * nothing about it (the caller then applies its own default).
     *
     * [keyArg] is the value patterns are matched against — the bash command,
     * the file path, the URL, the github op, the task type.
     */
    fun permissionFor(tool: String, keyArg: String): Permission? =
        when (val rule = permissions[normalizeTool(tool)]) {
            null -> null
            is PermissionRule.Simple -> rule.permission
            is PermissionRule.Patterned -> rule.entries.firstOrNull { globMatches(it.first, keyArg) }?.second
        }

    fun agent(name: String): AgentDef? = agents[name]

    fun command(name: String): CommandDef? = commands[name]

    /** Every command name, sorted, for `/help`. */
    fun commandNames(): List<String> = commands.keys.sorted()

    /** Every agent name, sorted, for `/agents`. */
    fun agentNames(): List<String> = agents.keys.sorted()

    companion object {
        /** Agent names that ship with the app (also valid `task` types). */
        val BUILTIN_AGENTS = listOf("build", "plan", "explore", "general")

        private val TOOL_ALIASES = mapOf(
            "edit" to "edit", "write" to "write", "patch" to "apply_patch",
            "apply_patch" to "apply_patch", "bash" to "bash", "read" to "read",
            "list" to "list", "glob" to "glob", "grep" to "grep",
            "webfetch" to "webfetch", "websearch" to "websearch", "skill" to "skill",
            "question" to "question", "todowrite" to "todowrite", "todoread" to "todoread",
            "github" to "github", "task" to "task",
        )

                 ?: if (isReadOnly(name, args)) OpenCodeConfig.Permission.ALLOW
                 else if (toolApprover != null) OpenCodeConfig.Permission.ASK
                 else OpenCodeConfig.Permission.ALLOW
             when (decision) {
                 OpenCodeConfig.Permission.DENY -> return "(запрещено настройками: $name)"
                 OpenCodeConfig.Permission.ASK -> {
                     val approver = toolApprover
                         ?: return "(нужно подтверждение для $name — включите режим «Вручную» или разрешите инструмент в opencode.json)"
                     if (!approver(name, argsJson)) return "(отклонено пользователем)"
                 }
                 OpenCodeConfig.Permission.ALLOW -> Unit
             }
             when (name) {
                 "bash" -> doBash(args)
                 "read" -> doRead(args)
                 "write" -> doWrite(args)
                 "edit" -> doEdit(args)
                 "list" -> doList(args)
                 "glob" -> doGlob(args)
                 "grep" -> doGrep(args)
                 "apply_patch" -> doApplyPatch(args)
                 "todowrite" -> doTodoWrite(args)

                 "websearch" -> doWebSearch(args)
                 "skill" -> doSkill(args)
                 "question" -> doQuestion(args)
                 "github" -> doGitHub(args)
                 "task" -> doTask(args)
                 else -> "unknown tool: $name"
             }
         } catch (t: Throwable) {
             "error: ${t.message ?: t.javaClass.simpleName}"
         }
     }
 
     /** True when the call cannot change anything (auto-approved in manual mode). */

         else -> false

     private fun base(): File = projectDir ?: workspace.root
 
     private fun doBash(args: JSONObject): String {
         val command = args.getString("command")
         val timeout = args.optLong("timeout", BASH_TIMEOUT_MS).coerceIn(1_000, BASH_TIMEOUT_MS)
         val r = shell.execute(command, base(), timeout)
         val out = buildString {
             append("exit code: ").append(r.exitCode).append('\n')
             if (r.output.isNotBlank()) append(r.output.trimEnd()).append('\n')
         }
         return out.trim().take(MAX_TOOL_OUTPUT)
     }
 
     private fun doRead(args: JSONObject): String {
         val f = resolve(args.getString("filePath")) ?: return "error: путь вне песочницы"
         if (!f.exists()) return "error: файл не найден: ${args.getString("filePath")}"
         if (f.isDirectory) return "error: это каталог, используйте list"
         val text = f.readText(Charsets.UTF_8)
         val offset = args.optInt("offset", 1).coerceAtLeast(1)
         val limit = args.optInt("limit", 0)
         val lines = text.lines()
         val from = (offset - 1).coerceIn(0, lines.size)
         val to = if (limit > 0) minOf(from + limit, lines.size) else lines.size
         val picked = lines.subList(from, to)
         val body = picked.mapIndexed { i, line -> "${from + i + 1}: $line" }.joinToString("\n")
         return (body.take(MAX_READ) + if (body.length > MAX_READ) "\n… (обрезано)" else "")
             .ifEmpty { "(пустой файл)" }
     }

     private fun doEdit(args: JSONObject): String {

         if (!f.isFile) return "error: файл не найден: ${args.getString("filePath")}"
         val old = args.getString("oldString")
         val new = args.optString("newString", "")
         if (old.isEmpty()) return "error: oldString пуст"
         val text = f.readText(Charsets.UTF_8)
         val count = countOccurrences(text, old)
         if (count == 0) return "error: oldString не найден в файле"
         if (count > 1 && !args.optBoolean("replaceAll", false)) {
             return "error: oldString встречается $count раз — уточните текст или передайте replaceAll: true"
         }
         val updated = if (args.optBoolean("replaceAll", false)) text.replace(old, new) else text.replaceFirst(old, new)
         onBeforeWrite?.invoke(f)
         f.writeText(updated, Charsets.UTF_8)
-        return "ok: заменено вхождений: ${if (args.optBoolean("replaceAll", false)) count else 1}"
+        val note = formatFile(f)
+        return "ok: заменено вхождений: ${if (args.optBoolean("replaceAll", false)) count else 1}" + (note?.let { " ($it)" } ?: "")
     }
 
     private fun doList(args: JSONObject): String {
         val path = args.optString("path", ".")
         val dir = resolve(path) ?: return "error: путь вне песочницы"
         if (!dir.exists()) return "error: нет такого каталога: $path"
         if (!dir.isDirectory) return "error: не каталог: $path"
         val entries = dir.listFiles()
             ?.filter { !hidden(it, it.isDirectory) }
             ?.sortedWith(compareByDescending<File> { it.isDirectory }.thenBy { it.name })
             ?: return "(empty)"
         if (entries.isEmpty()) return "(empty)"
         return entries.take(200).joinToString("\n") { f -> if (f.isDirectory) f.name + "/" else f.name + " (${f.length()} bytes)" }
     }

     private fun parseSearchResults(html: String): String {
         val linkRegex = Regex(
             """<a[^>]*class="[^"]*result__a[^"]*"[^>]*href="([^"]+)"[^>]*>(.*?)</a>""",
             setOf(RegexOption.DOT_MATCHES_ALL, RegexOption.IGNORE_CASE),
         )
         val snippetRegex = Regex(
             """<(?:a|td)[^>]*class="[^"]*result__snippet[^"]*"[^>]*>(.*?)</(?:a|td)>""",
             setOf(RegexOption.DOT_MATCHES_ALL, RegexOption.IGNORE_CASE),
         )
         val links = linkRegex.findAll(html).toList()
         if (links.isEmpty()) return "(ничего не найдено)"
         val snippets = snippetRegex.findAll(html).map { stripHtml(it.groupValues[1]).trim() }.toList()
         return links.take(8).mapIndexed { i, m ->
             val rawHref = m.groupValues[1]
             val title = stripHtml(m.groupValues[2]).trim()
             val link = decodeResultUrl(rawHref)
             val snippet = snippets.getOrNull(i).orEmpty()
             buildString {
                 append("${i + 1}. $title")
                 append("\n   $link")
                 if (snippet.isNotBlank()) append("\n   ${snippet.take(300)}")
             }
         }.joinToString("\n\n").take(MAX_WEB)
     }
 
     /** DuckDuckGo wraps result links in a /l/?uddg=<url> redirect. */
     private fun decodeResultUrl(href: String): String {
         val target = Regex("[?&]uddg=([^&]+)").find(href)?.groupValues?.get(1) ?: return href
         return try {
             java.net.URLDecoder.decode(target, "UTF-8")
         } catch (t: Throwable) {
             href
         }
     }

     private fun countOccurrences(text: String, needle: String): Int {
         var count = 0
         var idx = 0
         while (true) {
             idx = text.indexOf(needle, idx)
             if (idx < 0) return count
             count++
             idx += needle.length
         }
     }
 
     private fun globToRegex(pattern: String): Regex {
         val regex = buildString {
             append('^')
             var i = 0
             while (i < pattern.length) {
                 when (val c = pattern[i]) {
                     '*' -> if (i + 1 < pattern.length && pattern[i + 1] == '*') { append(".*"); i++ } else append("[^/]*")
                     '?' -> append('.')
                     else -> if (c in "\\^$.|+()[]{}") { append('\\'); append(c) } else append(c)
                 }
                 i++
             }
             append('$')
         }
         return Regex(regex)
     }
 
     private fun stripHtml(html: String): String {
         return html
             .replace(Regex("(?is)<(script|style)[^>]*>.*?</\\1>"), " ")
             .replace(Regex("(?s)<!--.*?-->"), " ")
             .replace(Regex("(?s)<br[^>]*>|</p>|</div>|</li>"), "\n")
             .replace(Regex("(?s)<[^>]+>"), " ")
             .replace(" ", " ").replace("&", "&").replace("<", "<")
             .replace(">", ">").replace(""", "\"").replace("'", "'")
             .replace(Regex("[ \\t\\x0B\\f\\r]+"), " ")
             .replace(Regex("\\n\\s*\\n+"), "\n")
             .trim()
     }

 # PocketRun — статус, архитектура и что осталось сделать
 
 Дата: 26 сентября 2026
 Репозиторий: `sj0404-collab/pocketrun` (приватный)
 CI: `.github/workflows/android.yml` — сборка APK и тесты в GitHub Actions, локальная сборка не нужна.
 
 ---
 
 ## 1. Что это
 
 Упрощённый оригинал (не аналог того, что есть в маркетплейсах) — Android-приложение
 на Kotlin, внутри которого живут:
 
 | Слой | Реализация | Состояние |
 |---|---|---|
 | Python | настоящий CPython 3.13 через Chaquopy | бутстрап + Kotlin-мост `PythonRuntime` готовы |
 | Node.js | настоящий Node 18 (nodejs-mobile) + Rhino-фолбэк | готово |
 | npx | свой: реестр npm + распаковка tar + запуск `bin` | не начато |
 | opencode | инструменты, навыки, сессии и инструкции opencode-стиля (v1.3.0) | готово |
 | Релиз-ключ | Ed25519, офлайн-проверка, утилита keygen | **готово** |
 | Интерфейс | Jetpack Compose | MVP: активация → проекты → редактор+терминал → инфо |
 
 Ключевое ограничение, определившее архитектуру: **это Android без Termux**, то есть
 нет Linux-пространства пользователя. Отсюда решения ниже.
 
 ---
 
 ## 2. Ключевые технические решения
 
 ### 2.1 Node.js: настоящий Node 18, Rhino как фолбэк
 
 `nodejs-mobile` даёт настоящий Node 18 в виде `libnode.so` (~62 МБ на ABI), но
 без исполняемого файла. Android API 29+ запрещает запускать файлы из каталога
 данных приложения, поэтому:
 
 * берём `libnode.so` из релиза nodejs-mobile v18.20.4 (arm64-v8a, x86_64);
 * собираем лаунчер `cpp/noderunner.cpp` (`node::Start(argc, argv)`), линкуем
   NDK clang'ом и упаковываем как `libnoderunner.so` прямо в `jniLibs` — Android
   извлекает `lib*.so` в `nativeLibraryDir`, откуда их можно exec'нуть;
 * `packaging.jniLibs.useLegacyPackaging = true`, иначе библиотеки не
   распакуются из APK и исполняемого файла на диске не будет;
 * `runtime/js/NodeRuntime.kt` запускает `libnoderunner.so` через
   `ProcessBuilder` на каждый скрипт: настоящий изолированный и отменяемый
   процесс; `LD_LIBRARY_PATH`, `NODE_PATH` и cwd пробрасываются.
 
 Загрузка и сборка — Gradle-задачи `fetchNodeMobile` и `assembleNodeJniLibs`
 (кэш в `android/.nodejs-mobile`). Rhino + `assets/node/boot.js` остаются
 фолбэком, когда нативный лаунчер недоступен (например, JVM-тесты). APK растёт
 примерно вдвое.
 
 ### 2.2 Python
 
 Chaquopy 17.0.0 (плагин), CPython 3.13. Версия Python выбирается блоком
 `chaquopy { defaultConfig { version = "3.13" } }` в `android/app/build.gradle.kts`;
 зависимость `com.chaquo.python:python` для этого не работает — Chaquopy 17 её
 игнорирует и молча собирает дефолтный 3.10 (так было до сентября 2026).
 Плагин не публикует marker-артефакт, поэтому в `settings.gradle.kts` есть
 `resolutionStrategy.eachPlugin` с `useModule("com.chaquo.python:gradle:...")`.
 
 Пакеты Python ставятся на этапе сборки, а не во время работы:
 
 ```kotlin
 // android/app/build.gradle.kts
 chaquopy {
     defaultConfig { /* ... */ }
 }
 dependencies { /* ... */ }
 // pip { install("requests") }
 ```
 
 Предупреждение сборки `Failed to compile to .pyc format: Couldn't find Python 3.10`
 безвредно: на машине сборки нет CPython 3.10, Chaquopy просто не предкомпилирует
 *.pyc* и интерпретирует исходники. На устройство это не влияет. С сентября 2026 в CI
 стоит `actions/setup-python` с 3.13, совпадающим с версией приложения, поэтому
 *.pyc* компилируется и это предупреждение ушло.
 
 ### 2.3 Формат лицензионного ключа
 
 Ключ выглядит так:
 
 ```
 PRK1.<base64url(payload)>.<base64url(ed25519-подпись)>
 ```
 
 `payload` — канонический текстовый документ (не JSON, чтобы подпись была
 побитово воспроизводимой):
 
 ```
 PRK1
 name=Jane Doe
 seat=work-laptop
 plan=pro
 nbf=1750000000
 exp=1760000000
 ```
 
 Подпись покрывает **байты payload**, а не пересериализованный объект. Поэтому
 проверка идёт в строгом порядке: разделить ключ → проверить подпись по байтам →
 только потом парсить поля.
 
 Отслеживания нет: срок задаётся в ключе, отзыв невозможен by design. Смена
 параметров — это смена встроенного в APK публичного ключа.
 
 Публичный ключ вшивается в сборку из `android/license.pubkey`:
 
 ```
 ./tools/keygen/gradlew -p tools/keygen run --args="genkey --out android"
 ```
 
 Если файла нет, в APK попадает заглушка `DEMO…`, и приложение честно отказывает
 любому ключу с сообщением об этом.
 
 ### 2.4 Две разные вещи под словом «релиз-ключ»
 
 1. **Ключ активации** — лицензия пользователя, проверяется офлайн (выше).
 2. **Ключ подписи APK** — `android/keystore.properties` + `release` signingConfig.
    Без него `packageRelease` падает с понятной ошибкой. В CI подпись берётся из
    секретов `ANDROID_KEYSTORE_B64` / `_PASSWORD` / `KEY_ALIAS` / `KEY_PASSWORD`;
    если секретов нет, собирается только debug APK.
 
 ### 2.5 Вывод в терминал
 
 Рантаймы не пишут в stdout процесса. Они пишут в два файла в
 `workspace/cache/runs/<id>/`, а `OutputTailer` следит за ними и отдаёт строки
 в UI. Причины: пайп блокирует интерпретатор при медленном читателе, файл
 переживает падение UI, и stderr можно красить отдельно. Декодирование
 инкрементальное — многобайтный UTF-8 не рвётся на границе буфера.
 
 ### 2.6 Границы песочницы
 
 `core/Workspace.kt` — единственное место, где живут пути. Корень:
 `filesDir/workspace`. Внутри: `projects/`, `packages/`, `cache/`, `logs/`.
 `Workspace.resolve()` возвращает `null`, если путь уходит наружу; вызывающий код
 трактует это как «путь отклонён», а не «файла нет».
 
 ---
 
 ## 3. Что уже написано
 
 ```
 android/app/src/main/java/dev/pocketrun/
   MainActivity.kt                     заглушка
   core/Workspace.kt                   песочница, защита от выхода за корень
   license/LicenseFormat.kt            формат ключа (копия в tools/keygen)
   license/Ed25519.kt                  чистая Java Ed25519 для API 26+
   license/LicenseVerifier.kt          чистая проверка ключа: подпись + окно времени
   license/LicenseManager.kt           SharedPreferences + StateFlow, фичи по плану
   runtime/Exec.kt                     модель выполнения, интерфейс рантайма
   runtime/OutputTailer.kt             живой вывод из файлов
 android/app/src/main/python/
   pocketrun.py                        argv, sys.path, потоки, трейсбеки, пакеты
 android/app/src/test/java/dev/pocketrun/license/
   LicenseFormatTest.kt                золотой тест-вектор, общий с keygen
 tools/keygen/                         отдельный JVM-проект: genkey/issue/verify/inspect
 .github/workflows/android.yml         сборка APK + тесты в GitHub
 ```
 
 Тест-вектор (детерминированный сид → фиксированный ключ) зафиксирован в обоих
 проектах: `tools/keygen/.../LicenseFormatTest.kt` и
 `android/app/src/test/.../LicenseFormatTest.kt`. Расхождение формата валит одну
 из сборок.
 
 ---
 
 ## 4. Что осталось
 
 Порядок именно такой — каждый пункт опирается на предыдущий.
 
 ### 4.1 Python-мост (следующий шаг) ✅ готово (v1.1.0)
 
 `runtime/python/PythonRuntime.kt`:
 * `initAsync()` стартует `Python.start(AndroidPlatform(context))` один раз, из
   `PocketRunApplication.onCreate` на фоновом потоке — старт занимает около секунды;
 * `execute()` создаёт `out_path`/`err_path` в `workspace/cache/runs/<id>`,
   поднимает два `OutputTailer`, вызывает `pocketrun.run(script, argsJson, stdin,
   out, err, cwd)`, возвращает `ExecResult`;
 * `isAvailable()` и `version()` читаются из `pocketrun.interpreter_info()`;
 * **ограничение отмены:** Chaquopy не умеет прерывать вызов. `cancel()` ставит
   флаг, и по возвращению выдаётся код 130. Убийство процесса невозможно —
   это честно показано в UI.
 
 ### 4.2 Node ✅ готово: настоящий Node 18 + Rhino-фолбэк
 
 Нативный Node (основной путь на устройстве):
 
 * `cpp/noderunner.cpp` + Gradle-задачи `fetchNodeMobile` /
   `assembleNodeJniLibs` в `android/app/build.gradle.kts` — скачивают
   nodejs-mobile v18.20.4, собирают `libnoderunner.so` под arm64-v8a и x86_64 и
   кладут рядом `libnode.so` и NDK-ный `libc++_shared.so`;
 * `runtime/js/NodeRuntime.kt` (`SyncScriptRuntime`) — `ProcessBuilder` на
   каждый запуск, реальные stdout/stderr, отмена через `destroy()`, таймаут →
   код 124; `AppViewModel.activeNode` выбирает его, когда лаунчер есть, иначе
   падает на Rhino; `MiniShell`, `NpxRuntime` и `OpenCodeTools` работают через
   интерфейс `SyncScriptRuntime`.
 
 Rhino-фолбэк (когда нативного лаунчера нет, например в JVM-тестах):
 
 * `runtime/js/JsRuntime.kt` — Rhino 1.8.1 `Context` (`VERSION_ES6`,
   `setOptimizationLevel(-1)`, `initSafeStandardObjects`), мост `__pr` на
   BaseFunction-подклассах (Kotlin null → JS null, не undefined!), event loop
   по хукам `__prRunDue/__prPending/__prNextDue/__prExitCode/__prOnExit`,
   вывод через log-файлы и OutputTailer как у Python, отмена → код 130;
 * `assets/node/boot.js` — `require` (relative/json/`node_modules`/`packages/`,
   `__dirname`, `__setMainDir` для главного скрипта), `module.exports`,
   `path`, `process`, `console`, `os`, `util`, `events`, `url`/`querystring`,
   `http(s)` (синхронный через мост, фейк-асинхронный API), `assert`,
   `stream` (Readable/Writable/Duplex/Transform/PassThrough с буферизацией,
   `pipe`, `drain`/`finish`/`end`), таймеры, `Buffer` (utf8/base64/hex,
   кириллица), полифилл `Promise`;

   (`core/SystemInfo.kt`): `arch`/`release`/`hostname`/`cpus`/`totalmem`/
   `freemem`/`uptime`/`loadavg`/`networkInterfaces` (из `/proc` и `java.net`),
   `process.memoryUsage()`/`hrtime()`/`pid`; `fs.createReadStream` и
   `fs.createWriteStream` — настоящие потоки, а не заглушки;
   шебанг и `async function` срезаются при загрузке модулей;
 * песочница fs целиком на стороне моста (`Workspace.resolve`), выход за
   корень = ENOENT/EACCES;
 * проверено: десктоп-харнесс (78 кейсов) + JVM-тесты `JsRuntimeTest` в CI;
 * ограничение: нет class/async-await/import-export/spread-литералов —
   Rhino их не парсит; чистые ES5/ES6-пакеты работают.
 
 ### 4.3 npx ✅ готово (v1.2.0)
 
 * `runtime/npm/Semver.kt` — semver-парсер и диапазоны (`^`, `~`, `>= <`,
   `x`-диапазоны, `||`, prerelease-правила);
 * `runtime/npm/TarReader.kt` — распаковка `.tgz` (ustar + prefix-поле),
   защита от выхода за пределы каталога;
 * `runtime/npm/NpmRegistry.kt` — метаданные и tarball'ы с
   `registry.npmjs.org` (URLEncode для scoped, UA обязателен);
 * `runtime/npm/NpxRuntime.kt` — спецификаторы (`pkg`, `pkg@1.2.3`, `@scope/pkg@v`),

   конфликте версий — вложенно в `packages/<parent>/node_modules/`), выбор
   версии (exact/range/dist-tag/max satisfying), чтение `bin`, запуск через
   JsRuntime с cwd вызывающего; кэш-first как у настоящего npx;
 * проверено вживую: `cowsay@1.4.0` (11 пакетов, кириллица, повторный запуск из
   кэша), `semver@6.3.1` (валидация и диапазоны);

   при parse-ошибке печатается подсказка попробовать старую версию.

 * `agent/opencode/OpenCodeTools.kt` — инструменты opencode: `bash`, `read`,

 ### 4.5 Интерфейс
 
 Экраны: активация → список проектов → редактор + терминал → чат агента →
 пакеты. `MainActivity` сейчас заглушка.
 
 ### 4.6 Параллельные сессии и субагенты ✅ готово
 
 * `AppViewModel.SessionRun` — состояние одного хода (сообщения, todos,
   счётчики, вопрос/подтверждение, отмена), вынесено из общих полей; публичные
   `agentMessages`/`agentRunning`/… — это производные потоки от активной вкладки
   (`activeFlow` через `flatMapLatest`), плюс `runningSessionIds` для индикатора на

   `cmd-<uuid>.py|js` уникальны и файл удаляется после запуска.
 
 ### 4.7 Конфиг и «agency» ✅ готово
 
 * `agent/opencode/OpenCodeConfig.kt` — `opencode.json` (глобальный

   `webfetch`), выигрывает самый специфичный; исполняется в `OpenCodeTools`
   через `permissionResolver` (запрет/подтверждение/разрешение);

   (шаблон с `$ARGUMENTS`, `$1…$9` и `@файл`), запускаются как обычный ход;

-  плюс прежние `/new`, `/init`, `/continue`, `/skills`, `/help`.

+  `/skills`, `/help`.

+
+* **Инструменты.** К агенту добавлены `websearch` (поиск через

+  `workspace/opencode/cache/models-dev.json`, команда `/models dev`.
+* **Параметры модели на агента.** `temperature`, `top_p`, `max_tokens`,

 ---
 
 ## 5. Как проверять
 
 Всё собирается в CI, локальный Android SDK не нужен:
 
 ```bash
 gh run watch
 gh run download --name pocketrun-apk
 ```
 
 Только лицензионная логика (JVM, без Android):
 
 ```bash
 tools/keygen/gradlew -p tools/keygen test
 android/gradlew -p android :app:testDebugUnitTest
 ```
 
 Выпуск ключа:
 
 ```bash
 tools/keygen/gradlew -p tools/keygen run --args="issue --name 'Jane Doe' --seat laptop --plan pro --days 30"
 ```
 
 ## 6. Известные ограничения
 
 * **Нет отзыва лицензий.** Только срок действия и смена публичного ключа в сборке.
 * **Нет отмены запуска Python.** Chaquopy не прерывает вызов.
 * **npm-пакеты с нативными аддонами или postinstall-скриптами** через npx не
   заработают: на устройстве нет компилятора C/C++, чистый JS работает.
 * **applets BusyBox не ограничены песочницей** — это настоящие нативные
   процессы с UID приложения: они могут читать/писать всё, что доступно
   приложению, а не только workspace (встроенные команды остаются в jail).
 * **APK большой** — CPython 3.13 (~30–40 МБ на ABI) плюс `libnode.so`
   (~50 МБ на ABI в сжатом виде); сборка ограничена `arm64-v8a` и `x86_64`.
 * **Rhino-фолбэк ограничен** — если нативный лаунчер недоступен, `node`
   деградирует до ES6-слоя без class/async/import.
+* **MCP, плагины и пользовательские инструменты opencode не поддержаны.**
+  MCP требует долгоживущего процесса с обменом по stdio, а рантайм устройства
+  запускает команды одним вызовом; плагины/кастомные инструменты opencode —
+  это TS-модули с хук-API, которого у нас нет. Эти вещи честно отсутствуют,
+  а не эмулируются.

I'll implement a redo stack. Approach: on undo, before restoring, snapshot the current version of each file into `run.redoSnapshots` and track created files that were deleted (so redo can recreate). But FileHistory.snapshot of the current file gives a Version representing current content. To redo (re-apply the agent's changes), I need the "after" state. But `history.restore(version, file, projectDir)` already snapshots the current state before restoring (per summary: restore first snapshots current). So after undo, the "after" state (the agent's version) is in history as the newly snapshotted version. redo could restore that.

Simpler approach: capture redo entries during undo. For each file in turnSnapshots (before state), call `history.snapshot(file, projectDir)` to capture the current (post-agent) state as a Version, store in run.redoSnapshots (file to Version). Then for created files that we delete, record them in run.redoCreated so redo recreates... but the content is lost unless we read it before deletion. So read content before deleting and store.

Let me define in SessionRun:
- `val redoSnapshots = mutableListOf<Pair<File, Version>>()`
- `val redoCreated = mutableListOf<Pair<File, String>>()` (file to content) to recreate deleted files.

On undo:
- clear redo lists first.
- for each (file, version) in turnSnapshots: capture current: `history.snapshot(file, projectDir)?.let { run.redoSnapshots += file to it }`, then history.restore(version,...).
  Wait ordering matters; redoSnapshots after should be the "post-agent" content. history.snapshot returns a Version that can later be restored to recreate post-agent content. Good.
- for each created file being deleted: read its content first (if exists) into redoCreated, then delete.
- clear turn lists.

On redo:
- if redoSnapshots empty && redoCreated empty → message.
- restore each redoSnapshots version; recreate redoCreated files with content.
- clear redo lists. Also we could push the undone state onto turnSnapshots to allow undo again. For a real round-trip, set turnSnapshots/created to the undone state. That's more complex; I'll make redo re-apply and also record the pre-redo (undone) state into turn lists so /undo works again. Actually simpler: after redo, repopulate turn lists from the state we just overwrote. Hmm.

Let me keep it correct and simple:
- undo(): move turn state → redo state.
- redo(): move redo state → turn state (so you can undo again).

Implementation for redo:
```
val restoredNames = mutableListOf<String>()
// re-apply agent state
run.redoSnapshots.asReversed().forEach { (file, version) ->
   // capture current (undone) state for possible undo again
   if (file.isFile) history.snapshot(file, projectDir)?.let { run.turnSnapshots += file to it }
   else run.turnCreated += file
   if (history.restore(version, file, projectDir)) restoredNames += workspace.relativeTo(file)
}
run.redoCreated.asReversed().forEach { (f, content) ->
   if (f.isFile) history.snapshot(f, projectDir)?.let { run.turnSnapshots += f to it } else run.turnCreated += f
   f.parentFile?.mkdirs(); f.writeText(content, UTF_8); restoredNames += workspace.relativeTo(f)
}
run.redoSnapshots.clear(); run.redoCreated.clear(); run.turnFiles.clear()
```

data class FormatterDef(
        val name: String,
        val command: List<String>,
        val extensions: List<String>,
    )

    data class AgentDef(
        val name: String,
        val description: String,
        val mode: String?,
        val model: String?,
        val prompt: String?,
        val tools: Set<String>?,
        val global: Boolean,
        val file: File?,
        val temperature: Double? = null,
        val topP: Double? = null,
        val maxOutputTokens: Int? = null,
        val reasoningEffort: String? = null,
    )

    data class CommandDef(
        val name: String,
        val description: String,
        val template: String,
        val agent: String?,
        val model: String?,
        val global: Boolean,
    )

    /**
     * The configured permission for a tool call, or null when the config says
     * nothing about it (the caller then applies its own default).
     *
     * [keyArg] is the value patterns are matched against — the bash command,
     * the file path, the URL, the github op, the task type.
     */
    fun permissionFor(tool: String, keyArg: String): Permission? =
        when (val rule = permissions[normalizeTool(tool)]) {
            null -> null
            is PermissionRule.Simple -> rule.permission
            is PermissionRule.Patterned -> rule.entries.firstOrNull { globMatches(it.first, keyArg) }?.second
        }

    fun agent(name: String): AgentDef? = agents[name]

    fun command(name: String): CommandDef? = commands[name]

    /** Every command name, sorted, for `/help`. */
    fun commandNames(): List<String> = commands.keys.sorted()

package dev.pocketrun.agent.opencode

import dev.pocketrun.core.Workspace
import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Rule
import org.junit.Test
import org.junit.rules.TemporaryFolder
import java.io.File

/**
 * Instruction collection: project AGENTS.md (walking up to the workspace
 * root), CLAUDE.md fallback, the global workspace/opencode/AGENTS.md and the
 * `instructions` array of opencode.json.
 */
class InstructionsTest {

    @get:Rule
    val tmp = TemporaryFolder()

    private fun newWorkspace(): Workspace = Workspace.at(tmp.newFolder())

    @Test
    fun projectAgentsMdOnly() {
        val ws = newWorkspace()
        val project = File(ws.root, "projects/demo")
        project.mkdirs()
        File(project, "AGENTS.md").writeText("Правила проекта demo.")

        val r = Instructions(ws).collect(project)
        assertEquals(1, r.sources.size)
        assertTrue(r.text.contains("Правила проекта demo."))
    }

    @Test
    fun claudeMdFallsBack() {
        val ws = newWorkspace()
        val project = File(ws.root, "projects/demo")
        project.mkdirs()
        File(project, "CLAUDE.md").writeText("Claude rules.")

        val r = Instructions(ws).collect(project)
        assertTrue(r.text.contains("Claude rules."))
        assertTrue(r.sources.first().contains("CLAUDE.md"))
    }

    @Test
    fun agentsBeatsClaude() {
        val ws = newWorkspace()
        val project = File(ws.root, "projects/demo")
        project.mkdirs()
        File(project, "AGENTS.md").writeText("AGENTS wins.")
        File(project, "CLAUDE.md").writeText("CLAUDE loses.")

        val r = Instructions(ws).collect(project)
        assertTrue(r.text.contains("AGENTS wins."))
        assertTrue(!r.text.contains("CLAUDE loses."))
    }

    @Test
    fun globalPlusProjectChain() {
        val ws = newWorkspace()
        File(ws.root, "opencode").mkdirs()
        File(ws.root, "opencode/AGENTS.md").writeText("Глобальные правила.")
        val project = File(ws.root, "projects/demo")
        project.mkdirs()
        File(project, "AGENTS.md").writeText("Проектные правила.")

        val r = Instructions(ws).collect(project)
        assertTrue(r.text.contains("Проектные правила."))
        assertTrue(r.text.contains("Глобальные правила."))
        // nearest (project) source comes last in the chain — outer first
        assertEquals(2, r.sources.size)
    }

    @Test
    fun configInstructionsArray() {
        val ws = newWorkspace()
        val project = File(ws.root, "projects/demo")
        project.mkdirs()
        File(project, "extra.md").writeText("Доп. инструкции.")
        File(ws.root, "opencode").mkdirs()
        File(ws.root, "opencode/opencode.json").writeText("""{"instructions": ["extra.md"]}""")

        val r = Instructions(ws).collect(project)
        assertTrue(r.text.contains("Доп. инструкции."))
    }

    @Test
    fun emptyWhenNothingConfigured() {
        val ws = newWorkspace()
        val r = Instructions(ws).collect(File(ws.root, "projects/x"))
        assertEquals("", r.text)
        assertTrue(r.sources.isEmpty())
    }
}

@Test
    fun emptyWhenNothingConfigured() {
        val ws = newWorkspace()
        val r = Instructions(ws).collect(File(ws.root, "projects/x"))
        assertEquals("", r.text)
        assertTrue(r.sources.isEmpty())
    }

    @Test
    fun globInstructionEntryMatchesMultipleFiles() {
        val ws = newWorkspace()
        val project = File(ws.root, "projects/demo")
        File(project, "docs").mkdirs()
        File(project, "docs/a.md").writeText("Док A.")
        File(project, "docs/b.md").writeText("Док B.")
        File(ws.root, "opencode").mkdirs()
        File(ws.root, "opencode/opencode.json").writeText("""{"instructions": ["docs/*.md"]}""")

        val r = Instructions(ws).collect(project)
        assertTrue(r.text.contains("Док A."))
        assertTrue(r.text.contains("Док B."))
        assertEquals(2, r.sources.size)
    }

    @Test
    fun doubleStarInstructionEntryCrossesDirectories() {
        val ws = newWorkspace()
        val project = File(ws.root, "projects/demo")
        File(project, "docs/deep").mkdirs()
        File(project, "docs/top.md").writeText("Верхний.")
        File(project, "docs/deep/nested.md").writeText("Вложенный.")
        File(ws.root, "opencode").mkdirs()
        File(ws.root, "opencode/opencode.json").writeText("""{"instructions": ["docs/**/*.md"]}""")

        val r = Instructions(ws).collect(project)
        assertTrue(r.text.contains("Верхний."))
        assertTrue(r.text.contains("Вложенный."))
    }
}

parts.text:
Done. Everything from the list landed, tested, and released.

**What shipped in v1.11.0** (commit `6bf626c`, tag `v1.11.0`, release workflow `38572813375` succeeded):
- Tools: `websearch` (DuckDuckGo) + `todoread`; `read` shows line numbers; `list`/`glob`/`grep` honour `.gitignore`/`.ignore` (`Ignore.kt`).
- Global `tools` switches in `opencode.json` disable tools per agent.
- `provider` block (baseURL/apiKey/models) + `models.dev` catalog via `/models dev` (`ModelsDev.kt`, cached).
- Per-agent `temperature`/`top_p`/`max_tokens`/`reasoning_effort` wired into `LlmClient`.
- `formatter` commands run after `write`/`edit`/`apply_patch`.
- Fixed the `Instructions` `"For now"` stub — glob entries (`docs/**/*.md`) now expand.
- `/redo` (re-applies last `/undo`) and `/share` (export + system share).
- UI agent picker and command palette in the chat input.

**Tests:** 221 JVM (+11), 23 Python, all green.

**Honest gap (documented in `docs/PLAN.md` §6):** MCP servers, plugins, and opencode custom tools are not implemented — MCP needs a long-lived stdio process and plugins/custom tools need a TS hook API that this runtime doesn't provide, so I left them out rather than fake them.

Assets: `PocketRun-v1.11.0-release.apk`, `PocketRun-v1.11.0-debug.apk` — https://github.com/sj0404-collab/pocketrun/releases/tag/v1.11.0

parts.text:
The grep is noisy. Let me instead reason about gaps compared to opencode and the app architecture, grounded in what I know from this session's exploration. I should give a concise honest list.

Let me structure the answer: what's still missing (by category), and note which are intentionally infeasible vs. doable-but-not-done.

Known gaps:

1. MCP servers — not supported (documented).
2. Plugins (opencode JS/TS plugin hooks) — not supported.
3. Custom tools (`.opencode/tool/*.ts`) — not supported; only built-in tools.
4. Session sharing as a URL (opencode share creates an online link). Our `/share` exports JSON + Android share intent; no hosted links.
5. Server/IDE integrations: opencode has a TUI, `opencode serve` HTTP API, LSP integration, `--continue`/`--session` CLI. Our app is a client; no LSP (real diagnostics/completions), no HTTP server.
6. Formatter: only custom command formatters; opencode also has built-in formatters detection (prettier, gofmt, etc. auto). We require explicit config. Also we don't auto-detect formatters.
7. Permission/ask: our ask mode uses a simple boolean approver; opencode has richer per-tool prompts, "always allow" persistence, session-level grants. Ours doesn't persist "always allow".
8. Model/provider: we support custom provider entries + models.dev catalog view, but we don't do full auth flows (`opencode auth login`/OAuth), env var credentials, or model capability gating. No provider-specific parameters beyond the four knobs.
9. Agent features: no `@`-mention of agents/files in input, no auto-compaction on context overflow (only manual `/compact`), no token accounting/context visualization, no image/vision attachments (only file attachment as text?), no reasoning/thinking display streaming separately.
10. Tools missing: no `multiedit`/`patch` variants beyond apply_patch; no `download`/`upload`; no `semantic search`; no web page screenshot; no `browser` tool. opencode has `bash`, `edit`, `read`, `write`, `glob`, `grep`, `list`, `webfetch`, `todoread/write`, `task`, `skill`; we have those plus websearch. But no `patch`? We have apply_patch. Fine.
11. Session management: no session title editing in-app? Actually `/sessions` list + rename exists in the dialog. Fork exists. No "revert to message" (opencode `/undo` reverts last message+files; ours reverts files only, not conversation). Actually opencode's undo also removes messages? We only revert files.
12. Undo: doesn't cover bash-made changes (documented in message). redo works only for one level (single turn). No multi-level undo stack — undo only last turn.
13. Multi-level undo/redo: only last turn (turnSnapshots cleared each turn; no history of turns).
14. Command queue: no queued messages while agent runs (new task opens a new session/tab instead).
15. Search in chat/history: no full-text search across sessions.
16. Keyboard shortcuts / hardware keyboard support? Unknown.
17. Notifications for long-running/background turns? Probably none.
18. Cost/token usage display: none.
19. `AGENTS.md` generation `/init` exists. Good.
20. Auto-format/lint feedback loop after edits: formatters only, no lint.
21. GitHub: repo create/actions/artifacts supported; but no issue/PR review workflow beyond api? There is `github` op with push/file ops/api. Could be enough.
22. Tests/CI: no instrumentation tests, no UI tests.
23. `question` tool in ask mode — fine.
24. Local model / Ollama specifics — generic OpenAI-compatible endpoint; no auto-detect.
25. Streaming: SSE streaming exists? There's modelPreview. Possibly streaming of tokens. Not sure.
26. No support for reading PDFs/images natively (attachment copied as file, agent can only read text).
27. No workspace-wide symbol index / LSP.
28. No MCP → already.
29. No plugin → already.
30. No custom tool → already.
31. No auto-compaction; no context-window management beyond HistoryTrimmer.
32. No "share" link; no session import (only export). No `opencode import`.
33. No `agent` picker for subagent types in UI beyond task.
34. No per-project config UI; edit opencode.json manually.
35. No theme/localization (UI is Russian only).

I should present the most relevant gaps concisely, grouped, and mark which are feasible next vs. architectural blockers. The user likely wants "what's next to add". I should be honest and concise. Given the CLI tone guidance, keep it fairly short but this is an informational request that warrants a list.

I'll structure: hard blockers (architecture), doable next, and smaller polish. And maybe ask if they want me to implement a subset.

Let me verify a couple claims before asserting: does undo cover conversation? Let me check undoLastTurn—it only reverts files, and pushes an info item; it does not remove messages. So conversation undo is missing. opencode `/undo` reverts the last message and its changes. Actually opencode's undo reverts the last user message and file changes. So we're partial.

Also multi-level undo: turnSnapshots only last turn. True.

Let me check if there's auto-compaction or context management: HistoryTrimmer exists. Fine.

Let me verify streaming: search for SSE.

Good — streaming is implemented. History trimming exists (char-based, not token-based).

Now I have enough to answer. Let me give a concise, honest list of gaps. I'll keep it organized. Given the earlier established pattern, I'll offer to implement a subset.

Let me be careful to distinguish:
- Architecture blockers (can't do on-device easily)
- Feasible next features
- Polish

I'll write in Russian since the user writes Russian.

Keep it reasonably concise but this warrants a structured list. I'll avoid emojis.

Let me draft:

**Принципиально не влезает (архитектура устройства):**
- MCP-серверы (долгоживущий stdio-процесс)
- плагины opencode (TS hook-API)
- пользовательские инструменты `.opencode/tool/*.ts`
- LSP (диагностика/автодополнение) — нужны настоящие языковые серверы
- нативные npm-аддоны/postinstall, pip-пакеты, компиляция C/C++

**Реализуемо, но пока нет:**
- /undo откатывает только файлы последнего хода, не сообщения беседы; и только один ход (нет многоуровневого undo/redo)
- изменение файлов через bash не откатывается (только write/edit/apply_patch)
- нет авто-компакции при переполнении контекста (только ручной /compact); сжатие по символам, не по токенам
- нет учёта токенов/стоимости и индикатора заполнения контекста
- /share — это экспорт JSON + системный «поделиться», нет опубликованной ссылки как в opencode share
- нет импорта сессии (только экспорт)
- нет поиска по истории/сессиям
- «ask» подтверждение не запоминает «всегда разрешать» для инструмента/шаблона
- форматтеры только явные (нет авто-определения prettier/gofmt и т.п.)
- провайдеры: нет OAuth/`auth login`, env-переменных для ключей; только 4 параметра модели
- нет поддержки изображений/PDF (вложения идут как файлы, модель читает только текст)
- нет очереди сообщений, пока агент занят (вместо этого открывается новая сессия)
- нет уведомлений о завершении фонового хода
- нет `@`-упоминаний файлов/агентов в строке ввода
- UI только на русском; нет тем
- нет UI-тестов/инструментальных тестов в CI

Which of these are actually worth calling out? Maybe trim. I'll present a tight list and then ask which to tackle.

Actually the user asked simply "чего ещё не хватает" — what else is missing. A concise list. Let me not overdo. I'll group and maybe emphasize the top candidates.

I should also mention that what's done is released. Keep it short-ish.

Let me write the final answer. No tool use needed further.

I should keep under 4 lines? The guidance says keep concise but user asked for detail-ish. This is a list request; a structured list is appropriate. I'll aim for moderate length.

This is a substantial refactor. Let me think about multi-level undo/redo design.

Current model: per-run `turnSnapshots/turnCreated/turnFiles` and `redoSnapshots/redoCreated`, cleared each turn, only last turn.

New design: a stack of `TurnRecord` per run. Each turn records:
- `fileSnapshots: List<Pair<File, Version>>` (pre-turn versions)
- `createdFiles: List<File>`
- `fileKeys: MutableSet<String>` during capture
- `historyBefore: JSONArray` (or messages size) — the conversation history before the turn
- `itemsBefore: Int` — number of UI message items before the turn

Then undo pops the last TurnRecord, applies reversion (restore files, delete created, revert history + UI items), pushes to a redo stack (with captured post-turn state). Redo pops redo stack, re-applies.

Conversation revert: since `run.history` is the OpenAI-format array used for the next request, we can snapshot it (deep copy) before the turn and restore it. Also UI `messages` list: we can snapshot the whole list before the turn (it's a List<AgentItem>, immutable-ish). Simpler: store `messagesBefore: List<AgentItem>` and on undo set `run.messages.value = messagesBefore`. But careful: other turns might have happened concurrently? Within a single run, turns are sequential (can't start a new turn while running in same session — new task opens a new session). So within a run, sequential. Good.

package dev.pocketrun.agent

import android.content.Context

/**
 * Agent configuration, stored in SharedPreferences. Works with any
 * OpenAI-compatible `/chat/completions` endpoint: OpenAI, OpenRouter, Groq,
 * Together, a local llama.cpp/vLLM server on the Wi-Fi network, …
 *
 * Also carries the agent-behaviour knobs (permission mode, max rounds) and
 * the optional GitHub token used by the `github` tool.
 */
object AgentSettings {

    const val DEFAULT_BASE_URL = "https://api.openai.com/v1"
    const val DEFAULT_MODEL = "gpt-4o-mini"

    /** opencode Zen: the curated OpenAI-compatible gateway from opencode.ai/auth. */
    const val ZEN_BASE_URL = "https://opencode.ai/zen/v1"
    const val ZEN_AUTH_URL = "https://opencode.ai/auth"

    /** Where the user creates a GitHub PAT (scopes: repo, workflow). */
    const val GITHUB_TOKEN_URL = "https://github.com/settings/tokens/new?scopes=repo,workflow&description=PocketRun"
    const val GITHUB_API = "https://api.github.com"

    /** Permission modes for tool execution. */
    const val MODE_AUTO = "auto"     // everything runs without asking
    const val MODE_MANUAL = "manual" // mutations need a tap; reads run freely
    const val MODE_ASK = "ask"       // the agent asks clarifying questions first
    val MODES = listOf(MODE_AUTO, MODE_MANUAL, MODE_ASK)
    val MODE_LABELS = mapOf(MODE_AUTO to "Авто", MODE_MANUAL to "Вручную", MODE_ASK to "Вопросы")

    /**
     * Model rounds per user request. Each round is one model call plus the
     * tools it asked for, so a real task (edit a project, push it, wait for the
     * CI run, fix what broke) needs dozens of them — the old default of 12
     * stopped agents in the middle of ordinary work.
     */
    const val DEFAULT_MAX_STEPS = 40
    const val MAX_STEPS_LIMIT = 500

    /** Ready-made presets shown in the model settings dialog. */
    data class Preset(val label: String, val baseUrl: String, val model: String)

    val PRESETS = listOf(
        Preset("OpenCode Zen", ZEN_BASE_URL, "claude-sonnet-4-5"),
        Preset("OpenAI", "https://api.openai.com/v1", "gpt-4o-mini"),
        Preset("OpenRouter", "https://openrouter.ai/api/v1", "anthropic/claude-sonnet-4.5"),
        Preset("Groq", "https://api.groq.com/openai/v1", "llama-3.3-70b-versatile"),
    )

    data class Config(
        val baseUrl: String = DEFAULT_BASE_URL,
        val apiKey: String = "",
        val model: String = DEFAULT_MODEL,
        val githubToken: String = "",
        val confirmMode: String = MODE_AUTO,
        val maxSteps: Int = DEFAULT_MAX_STEPS,
        /**
         * Per-agent model options (from opencode.json). They are not persisted
         * in the UI prefs: the effective config is rebuilt each turn from the
         * config file, so these stay transient overrides.
         */
        val temperature: Double? = null,
        val topP: Double? = null,
        val maxOutputTokens: Int? = null,
        val reasoningEffort: String? = null,
    ) {
        /**
         * The API key is optional: local servers (llama.cpp, vLLM) need none,
         * and for Zen the server itself answers 403 without one — which the
         * agent surfaces with a hint. Only URL and model are required.
         */
        val isReady: Boolean get() = baseUrl.isNotBlank() && model.isNotBlank()
        val endpoint: String get() = baseUrl.trimEnd('/') + "/chat/completions"
        val isZen: Boolean get() = baseUrl.contains("opencode.ai/zen")
        val hasGitHub: Boolean get() = githubToken.isNotBlank()
        val safeMaxSteps: Int get() = maxSteps.coerceIn(1, MAX_STEPS_LIMIT)
    }

    private const val PREFS = "agent"

    fun read(context: Context): Config {
        val prefs = context.getSharedPreferences(PREFS, Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
        return Config(
            baseUrl = prefs.getString("baseUrl", DEFAULT_BASE_URL)!!.trim().trimEnd('/').ifBlank { DEFAULT_BASE_URL },
            apiKey = prefs.getString("apiKey", "")!!.trim(),
            model = prefs.getString("model", DEFAULT_MODEL)!!.trim().ifBlank { DEFAULT_MODEL },
            githubToken = prefs.getString("githubToken", "")!!.trim(),
            confirmMode = prefs.getString("confirmMode", MODE_AUTO)!!.trim().let { if (it in MODES) it else MODE_AUTO },
            maxSteps = prefs.getString("maxSteps", DEFAULT_MAX_STEPS.toString())!!.trim().toIntOrNull() ?: DEFAULT_MAX_STEPS,
        )
    }

    fun save(context: Context, config: Config) {
        context.getSharedPreferences(PREFS, Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
            .edit()
            .putString("baseUrl", config.baseUrl.trim().trimEnd('/'))
            .putString("apiKey", config.apiKey.trim())
            .putString("model", config.model.trim())
            .putString("githubToken", config.githubToken.trim())
            .putString("confirmMode", config.confirmMode)
            .putString("maxSteps", config.safeMaxSteps.toString())
            .apply()
    }

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------- ui state

    /**
     * Which session tab was active and which tabs were open, so the agent
     * chat comes back exactly as it was after the app is closed. Returns null
     * when nothing was saved yet (first launch → continue the latest session).
     */
    data class UiState(val lastSessionId: String?, val openTabs: List<String>)

    fun readUiState(context: Context): UiState? {
        val prefs = context.getSharedPreferences(PREFS, Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
        if (!prefs.contains("uiOpenTabs")) return null
        val last = prefs.getString("uiLastSessionId", "")!!.takeIf { it.isNotBlank() }
        val tabs = prefs.getString("uiOpenTabs", "")!!.split(',').filter { it.isNotBlank() }
        return UiState(last, tabs)
    }

    fun saveUiState(context: Context, lastSessionId: String?, openTabs: List<String>) {
        context.getSharedPreferences(PREFS, Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
            .edit()
            .putString("uiLastSessionId", lastSessionId ?: "")
            .putString("uiOpenTabs", openTabs.joinToString(","))
            .apply()
    }
}

12: /**
13:  * A thin OpenAI-compatible chat-completions client: POST JSON, read JSON, turn
14:  * the response into [Response] (text plus any tool calls).
15:  *
16:  * Three things matter for a mobile agent loop and are implemented here:
17:  *
18:  * * **Streaming.** The request asks for `stream: true` and the answer is read
19:  *   as SSE, so a generation that takes many minutes keeps the connection busy
20:  *   (idle connections get killed by gateways and mobile networks), the ⏹ button
21:  *   is honoured between chunks, and the UI can show what is being written. A
22:  *   server that answers with a plain JSON body instead is handled transparently.
23:  * * **Retries.** Timeouts, resets, 429 and 5xx are retried with a backoff;
24:  *   everything else (bad key, unknown model) fails immediately.
25:  * * **Long deadlines.** A model that thinks for a long time must not lose the
26:  *   turn: the read timeout is 15 minutes, and a watchdog aborts a connection
27:  *   that goes silent for much longer than that.
28:  */
29: class LlmClient(private val config: AgentSettings.Config) {
30: 
31:     data class ToolCall(val id: String, val name: String, val arguments: String)
32:     data class Response(val content: String?, val toolCalls: List<ToolCall>)
33: 
34:     class LlmException(message: String) : Exception(message)
35: 
36:     /** The server answered, but not in a form we can use — worth one plain retry. */
37:     private class UnusableAnswer(val detail: String) : Exception(detail)
38: 
39:     /** A non-2xx answer, kept structured so retries can look at the status. */
40:     private class HttpFailure(val status: Int, val body: String) : Exception("HTTP $status")
41: 
42:     companion object {
43:         const val CONNECT_TIMEOUT_MS = 30_000
44: 
45:         /** 15 minutes — a long generation must not lose the turn. */
46:         const val READ_TIMEOUT_MS = 900_000
47: 
48:         /** No bytes for this long (and none at all since the request) = dead connection. */
49:         const val FIRST_TOKEN_TIMEOUT_MS = 240_000
50: 
51:         /** A stream that goes quiet for this long after the first token is dead too. */
52:         const val STALL_TIMEOUT_MS = 300_000
53: 
54:         const val MAX_ATTEMPTS = 3
55:         const val RETRY_BACKOFF_MS = 3_000L
56:         const val CANCELLED = "остановлено пользователем"
57: 
58:         private const val SSE_DATA = "data:"
59:         private const val SSE_DONE = "[DONE]"
60: 
61:         /**
62:          * Fetches the model list of an OpenAI-compatible server:
63:          * GET {baseUrl}/models, parse data[].id. Used by the model settings UI
64:          * (e.g. the OpenCode Zen catalog at https://opencode.ai/zen/v1).
65:          */
66:         fun models(baseUrl: String, apiKey: String): List<String> {
67:             val url = baseUrl.trim().trimEnd('/') + "/models"
68:             val conn = (URL(url).openConnection() as HttpURLConnection).apply {
69:                 requestMethod = "GET"
70:                 connectTimeout = 20_000
71:                 readTimeout = 60_000
72:                 setRequestProperty("Accept", "application/json")
73:                 if (apiKey.isNotBlank()) setRequestProperty("Authorization", "Bearer $apiKey")
74:             }
75:             try {
76:                 val status = conn.responseCode
77:                 val text = (if (status in 200..299) conn.inputStream else conn.errorStream)
78:                     ?.bufferedReader(Charsets.UTF_8)?.use { it.readText() } ?: ""
79:                 if (status !in 200..299) {
80:                     throw LlmException("HTTP $status от $url: ${text.take(300)}")
81:                 }
82:                 val data = JSONObject(text).optJSONArray("data") ?: return emptyList()
83:                 val ids = mutableListOf<String>()
84:                 for (i in 0 until data.length()) {
85:                     val id = data.optJSONObject(i)?.optString("id").orEmpty()
86:                     if (id.isNotEmpty()) ids += id
87:                 }
88:                 return ids.sortedWith(compareBy<String> { it.lowercase() })
89:             } finally {
90:                 conn.disconnect()
91:             }
92:         }
93: 
94:         /**
95:          * Accumulates an OpenAI-style SSE stream: text deltas plus tool calls
96:          * whose name and arguments arrive in pieces. Kept separate from the
97:          * socket code so it can be tested without a server.
98:          */
99:         internal class Stream(
100:             private val onDelta: ((String) -> Unit)? = null,
101:         ) {
102:             private val text = StringBuilder()
103:             private val reasoning = StringBuilder()
104:             private val calls = LinkedHashMap<Int, Call>()
105: 
106:             private class Call {
107:                 var id: String = ""
108:                 var name: String = ""
109:                 val arguments = StringBuilder()
110:             }
111: 
112:             /** Feeds one `data:` payload; malformed chunks are ignored. */
113:             fun feed(payload: String) {
114:                 val json = try {
115:                     JSONObject(payload)
116:                 } catch (t: Throwable) {
117:                     return
118:                 }
119:                 json.optJSONObject("error")?.let { err ->
120:                     val msg = err.optString("message").ifEmpty { payload.take(200) }
121:                     throw LlmException("сервер модели вернул ошибку: $msg")
122:                 }
123:                 val choice = json.optJSONArray("choices")?.optJSONObject(0) ?: return
124:                 // `delta` for streams, `message` for servers that stream nothing.
125:                 val delta = choice.optJSONObject("delta") ?: choice.optJSONObject("message") ?: return
126:                 delta.optString("content").takeIf { it.isNotEmpty() }?.let {
127:                     text.append(it)
128:                     onDelta?.invoke(it)
129:                 }
130:                 // Reasoning models stream their thinking separately; keep it so a
131:                 // blank `content` still produces something useful.
132:                 delta.optString("reasoning_content").takeIf { it.isNotEmpty() }?.let { reasoning.append(it) }
133:                 val arr = delta.optJSONArray("tool_calls") ?: return
134:                 for (i in 0 until arr.length()) {
135:                     val chunk = arr.optJSONObject(i) ?: continue
136:                     val slot = calls.getOrPut(chunk.optInt("index", i)) { Call() }
137:                     chunk.optString("id").takeIf { it.isNotEmpty() }?.let { slot.id = it }

 /**

 object AgentSettings {
 
     const val DEFAULT_BASE_URL = "https://api.openai.com/v1"
     const val DEFAULT_MODEL = "gpt-4o-mini"

     const val GITHUB_API = "https://api.github.com"

     const val MODE_AUTO = "auto"     // everything runs without asking
     const val MODE_MANUAL = "manual" // mutations need a tap; reads run freely
     const val MODE_ASK = "ask"       // the agent asks clarifying questions first

      * stopped agents in the middle of ordinary work.
      */
     const val DEFAULT_MAX_STEPS = 40
     const val MAX_STEPS_LIMIT = 500
 
     /** Ready-made presets shown in the model settings dialog. */

     val PRESETS = listOf(

         Preset("OpenAI", "https://api.openai.com/v1", "gpt-4o-mini"),
         Preset("OpenRouter", "https://openrouter.ai/api/v1", "anthropic/claude-sonnet-4.5"),
         Preset("Groq", "https://api.groq.com/openai/v1", "llama-3.3-70b-versatile"),
     )
 
     data class Config(
         val baseUrl: String = DEFAULT_BASE_URL,
         val apiKey: String = "",
         val model: String = DEFAULT_MODEL,
         val githubToken: String = "",
         val confirmMode: String = MODE_AUTO,
         val maxSteps: Int = DEFAULT_MAX_STEPS,
         /**

         val reasoningEffort: String? = null,
     ) {
         /**
          * The API key is optional: local servers (llama.cpp, vLLM) need none,
          * and for Zen the server itself answers 403 without one — which the
          * agent surfaces with a hint. Only URL and model are required.
          */
         val isReady: Boolean get() = baseUrl.isNotBlank() && model.isNotBlank()
         val endpoint: String get() = baseUrl.trimEnd('/') + "/chat/completions"
         val isZen: Boolean get() = baseUrl.contains("opencode.ai/zen")
         val hasGitHub: Boolean get() = githubToken.isNotBlank()
         val safeMaxSteps: Int get() = maxSteps.coerceIn(1, MAX_STEPS_LIMIT)
     }
 
     private const val PREFS = "agent"
 
     fun read(context: Context): Config {
         val prefs = context.getSharedPreferences(PREFS, Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
         return Config(
             baseUrl = prefs.getString("baseUrl", DEFAULT_BASE_URL)!!.trim().trimEnd('/').ifBlank { DEFAULT_BASE_URL },

     fun readUiState(context: Context): UiState? {

             .putString("uiOpenTabs", openTabs.joinToString(","))

+package dev.pocketrun.agent
+
+import android.app.NotificationChannel
+import android.app.NotificationManager
+import android.app.PendingIntent
+import android.content.Context
+import android.content.Intent
+import android.os.Build
+import androidx.core.app.NotificationCompat
+import androidx.core.app.NotificationManagerCompat
+import dev.pocketrun.MainActivity
+import dev.pocketrun.R
+
+/**
+ * Heads-up notification for a turn that finished while the app was in the
+ * background, so a long build or a CI wait does not go unnoticed. The channel
+ * is created lazily and the permission is checked before posting.
+ */
+object TurnNotifier {
+
+    private const val CHANNEL_ID = "turns"
+    private const val NOTIFICATION_ID = 1001
+
+    /** Whether the UI is visible; a turn finishing hidden posts a heads-up. */
+    @Volatile
+    var inForeground: Boolean = true
+
+    fun setForeground(foreground: Boolean) { inForeground = foreground }
+
+    fun notifyTurnFinished(context: Context, title: String, body: String) {
+        if (inForeground) return
+        ensureChannel(context)
+        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT < Build.VERSION_CODES.O) return
+        val manager = context.getSystemService(NotificationManager::class.java) ?: return
+        if (manager.getNotificationChannel(CHANNEL_ID) != null) return
+        val channel = NotificationChannel(
+            CHANNEL_ID,
+            "Ходы агента",
+            NotificationManager.IMPORTANCE_DEFAULT,
+        ).apply { description = "Завершение фоновых ходов агента" }
+        manager.createNotificationChannel(channel)
+    }
+
+    fun notifyTurnFinished(context: Context, title: String, body: String) {
+        ensureChannel(context)
+        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.TIRAMISU) {
+            val granted = context.checkSelfPermission(android.Manifest.permission.POST_NOTIFICATIONS) ==
+                android.content.pm.PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED
+            if (!granted) return
+        }
+        val intent = Intent(context, MainActivity::class.java).apply {
+            flags = Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_NEW_TASK or Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_CLEAR_TOP
+        }
+        val pending = PendingIntent.getActivity(
+            context,
+            0,
+            intent,
+            PendingIntent.FLAG_UPDATE_CURRENT or PendingIntent.FLAG_IMMUTABLE,
+        )
+        val notification = NotificationCompat.Builder(context, CHANNEL_ID)
+            .setSmallIcon(R.mipmap.ic_launcher)
+            .setContentTitle(title)
+            .setContentText(body)
+            .setStyle(NotificationCompat.BigTextStyle().bigText(body))
+            .setAutoCancel(true)
+            .setContentIntent(pending)
+            .build()
+        runCatching { NotificationManagerCompat.from(context).notify(NOTIFICATION_ID, notification) }
+    }
+}

fun saveUiState(context: Context, lastSessionId: String?, openTabs: List<String>) {
        context.getSharedPreferences(PREFS, Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
            .edit()
            .putString("uiLastSessionId", lastSessionId ?: "")
            .putString("uiOpenTabs", openTabs.joinToString(","))
            .apply()
    }

    /**
     * Tools/argument patterns the user chose "always allow" for, as
     * `tool::glob` strings. They win over the ask/manual confirmation.
     */
    fun approvedRules(context: Context): Set<String> =
        context.getSharedPreferences(PREFS, Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
            .getStringSet("approvedRules", emptySet())?.toSet() ?: emptySet()

    fun rememberApproval(context: Context, rule: String) {
        val current = approvedRules(context)
        context.getSharedPreferences(PREFS, Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
            .edit()
            .putStringSet("approvedRules", current + rule)
            .apply()
    }

    fun forgetApproval(context: Context, rule: String) {
        val current = approvedRules(context)
        context.getSharedPreferences(PREFS, Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
            .edit()
            .putStringSet("approvedRules", current - rule)
            .apply()
    }
}

package dev.pocketrun.agent

import android.app.NotificationChannel
import android.app.NotificationManager
import android.app.PendingIntent
import android.content.Context
import android.content.Intent
import android.os.Build
import androidx.core.app.NotificationCompat
import androidx.core.app.NotificationManagerCompat
import dev.pocketrun.MainActivity
import dev.pocketrun.R

/**
 * Heads-up notification for a turn that finished while the app was in the
 * background, so a long build or a CI wait does not go unnoticed. The channel
 * is created lazily and the permission is checked before posting.
 */
object TurnNotifier {

    private const val CHANNEL_ID = "turns"
    private const val NOTIFICATION_ID = 1001

    fun ensureChannel(context: Context) {
        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT < Build.VERSION_CODES.O) return
        val manager = context.getSystemService(NotificationManager::class.java) ?: return
        if (manager.getNotificationChannel(CHANNEL_ID) != null) return
        val channel = NotificationChannel(
            CHANNEL_ID,
            "Ходы агента",
            NotificationManager.IMPORTANCE_DEFAULT,
        ).apply { description = "Завершение фоновых ходов агента" }
        manager.createNotificationChannel(channel)
    }

    fun notifyTurnFinished(context: Context, title: String, body: String) {
        ensureChannel(context)
        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.TIRAMISU) {
            val granted = context.checkSelfPermission(android.Manifest.permission.POST_NOTIFICATIONS) ==
                android.content.pm.PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED
            if (!granted) return
        }
        val intent = Intent(context, MainActivity::class.java).apply {
            flags = Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_NEW_TASK or Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_CLEAR_TOP
        }
        val pending = PendingIntent.getActivity(
            context,
            0,
            intent,
            PendingIntent.FLAG_UPDATE_CURRENT or PendingIntent.FLAG_IMMUTABLE,
        )
        val notification = NotificationCompat.Builder(context, CHANNEL_ID)
            .setSmallIcon(R.mipmap.ic_launcher)
            .setContentTitle(title)
            .setContentText(body)
            .setStyle(NotificationCompat.BigTextStyle().bigText(body))
            .setAutoCancel(true)
            .setContentIntent(pending)
            .build()
        runCatching { NotificationManagerCompat.from(context).notify(NOTIFICATION_ID, notification) }
    }
}

package dev.pocketrun.agent

import android.app.NotificationChannel
import android.app.NotificationManager
import android.app.PendingIntent
import android.content.Context
import android.content.Intent
import android.os.Build
import androidx.core.app.NotificationCompat
import androidx.core.app.NotificationManagerCompat
import dev.pocketrun.MainActivity
import dev.pocketrun.R

/**
 * Heads-up notification for a turn that finished while the app was in the
 * background, so a long build or a CI wait does not go unnoticed. The channel
 * is created lazily and the permission is checked before posting.
 */
object TurnNotifier {

    private const val CHANNEL_ID = "turns"
    private const val NOTIFICATION_ID = 1001

    /** Whether the UI is visible; a turn finishing hidden posts a heads-up. */
    @Volatile
    var inForeground: Boolean = true

    fun setForeground(foreground: Boolean) { inForeground = foreground }

    fun notifyTurnFinished(context: Context, title: String, body: String) {
        if (inForeground) return
        ensureChannel(context)
        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT < Build.VERSION_CODES.O) return
        val manager = context.getSystemService(NotificationManager::class.java) ?: return
        if (manager.getNotificationChannel(CHANNEL_ID) != null) return
        val channel = NotificationChannel(
            CHANNEL_ID,
            "Ходы агента",
            NotificationManager.IMPORTANCE_DEFAULT,
        ).apply { description = "Завершение фоновых ходов агента" }
        manager.createNotificationChannel(channel)
    }

    fun notifyTurnFinished(context: Context, title: String, body: String) {
        ensureChannel(context)
        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.TIRAMISU) {
            val granted = context.checkSelfPermission(android.Manifest.permission.POST_NOTIFICATIONS) ==
                android.content.pm.PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED
            if (!granted) return
        }
        val intent = Intent(context, MainActivity::class.java).apply {
            flags = Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_NEW_TASK or Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_CLEAR_TOP
        }
        val pending = PendingIntent.getActivity(
            context,
            0,
            intent,
            PendingIntent.FLAG_UPDATE_CURRENT or PendingIntent.FLAG_IMMUTABLE,
        )
        val notification = NotificationCompat.Builder(context, CHANNEL_ID)
            .setSmallIcon(R.mipmap.ic_launcher)
            .setContentTitle(title)
            .setContentText(body)
            .setStyle(NotificationCompat.BigTextStyle().bigText(body))
            .setAutoCancel(true)
            .setContentIntent(pending)
            .build()
        runCatching { NotificationManagerCompat.from(context).notify(NOTIFICATION_ID, notification) }
    }
}
